title: Manager - Global CM Documentation & Industrialization Hub
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
DESCRIPTION:
  
  
We are seeking a Manager - Global CM Documentation & Industrialization Hub to establish and lead a centralized capability supporting engineering documentation, industrialization readiness, operational governance, and knowledge management across Thermo Fisher Scientific's global Contract Manufacturing and OEM network.
  
  
This role will serve as the product owner for the CM Documentation Hub, CM Portal, and Idea Portal while partnering with Regional Directors, R&D, Procurement, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and external manufacturing partners. The position will build scalable systems, global standards, and manufacturing knowledge infrastructure that improve supplier performance, accelerate technology transfers, strengthen cost transparency, and enable operational excellence.
  
  
The role is centered on Contract Manufacturing and OEM management excellence, operations strategy support including Make/Buy and Core/Non-Core assessments, and co-manufacturing site operations and supply intervention support. Initial scope includes technology transfer documentation, CM Portal and Idea Portal governance, and global best-practice deployment, with future expansion into Bill of Process (BOP), Bill of Equipment (BOE), and Bill of Quality (BOQ).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the Global CM Documentation & Industrialization Hub, including operating model, governance cadence, role clarity, and stakeholder engagement model
* Own the strategic roadmap, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CM Portal, Idea Portal, documentation library, and associated knowledge management capabilities
* Develop scalable engineering documentation standards, templates, playbooks, and lifecycle management processes across the global CM and OEM network
* Lead standardization of technology transfer documentation, manufacturing readiness assessments, supplier industrialization support, and operational governance routines
* Partner with Regional Directors and cross-functional leaders to support Contract Manufacturing and OEM management excellence across commercial, operational, performance, quality, and engineering dimensions
* Support Make/Buy and Core/Non-Core operations strategy initiatives by enabling structured manufacturing data, process documentation, supplier capability inputs, and cost transparency insights
* Support co-manufacturing site operations and supply intervention activities through engineering coordination, documentation readiness, risk tracking, and escalation management
* Develop and maintain global best-practice libraries, lessons learned, engineering standards, and reusable templates to accelerate deployment across external manufacturing partners
* Build and execute the roadmap for future BOP, BOE, and BOQ deployment, including governance, ownership model, data structure, and change control requirements
* Establish operational metrics and reporting to monitor documentation maturity, industrialization readiness, supplier execution, technology transfer progress, and continuous improvement impact
* Drive value engineering and cost transparency initiatives by structuring manufacturing process, equipment, quality, and supplier capability data in a consistent way
* Build, coach, and develop a high-performing team supporting global external manufacturing operations in a matrixed environment

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree with 12+ years of experience or Master's degree with 10+ years of experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical discipline
* Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrialization, technical operations, engineering governance, contract manufacturing, OEM management, or external manufacturing operations
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives or technical teams in a global, matrixed organization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong experience with Contract Manufacturing, OEM operations, supplier industrialization, and external manufacturing governance
* Demonstrated ability to establish new operating models, governance frameworks, and scalable documentation or knowledge management systems
* Experience supporting technology transfers, new product introductions, product transfers, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp-up activities
* Working knowledge of Make/Buy analysis, Core/Non-Core assessments, supplier capability evaluation, and manufacturing network strategy
* Experience with PLM, ERP, SharePoint, document management systems, workflow automation, digital manufacturing platforms, or similar systems
* Strong understanding of manufacturing standards, quality systems, engineering change control, supplier performance management, and operational excellence
* Lean Six Sigma, PMP, product owner, change management, or operational excellence certification preferred
* Strong analytical and business acumen with ability to translate manufacturing information into actionable operational decisions
* Excellent communication, executive presentation, stakeholder influence, and change leadership skills
* Ability to travel up to 25% to support global contract manufacturing operations

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic operational leadership with strong execution discipline
* Contract Manufacturing and OEM governance mindset
* Documentation governance and industrialization excellence
* Cross-functional influence across global matrix teams
* Data-driven decision-making and performance management
* Continuous improvement and value engineering orientation
* Talent development, coaching, and organizational capability building
* Strong ownership, accountability, and customer-focused execution

title: Content Author
description:
**Job Description**
The Content Author is an entry point into the content team's career path, combining hands-on content authorship with full ownership of the content production process. This role analyzes source material from multiple resources and writes, edits, and updates clear, accurate, customer-facing content, while also performing the technical production tasks — coding, copyreading, merging, rendering, loading, and validating — needed to move that content through the team's systems and into publication. The Content Author works under the guidance of more senior team members while building independent proficiency in the team's content, processes, and systems, with the goal of taking on progressively broader responsibility over time. Specific product knowledge is not required at entry; the role is designed around generalizable content and systems skills that apply across the team's product portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Read source material from multiple places and write, edit, and update content so it's clear and correct, with guidance from senior team members.
* Handle the full content production process in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): coding, copyreading, editing, merging, DITA formatting, and checking content.
* Turn confusing, incomplete, or mixed-up source material into clear, well-organized content for customers.
* Take ownership of your own content's accuracy and completeness; work independently on familiar tasks and ask for help on harder ones.
* Spot routine content problems, fix what you can, and know when to ask for help on anything unclear.
* Meet deadlines by managing your own workload and working well with teammates.
* Help test and review content to make sure it works and reads well across different formats.
* Suggest small process improvements when you spot them.
* Leverage strong product knowledge to enhance our workflow and content, for strategic products.
* Learn the team's content, systems, and tools, and pick up general product knowledge over time.

**Required Qualifications**

* Process-oriented: comfortable following and improving structured, multi-step content workflows.
* Attention to detail: consistently accurate, complete, and quality-checked work.
* Strong writing skills: clear, well-organized, professional writing across content types.
* Strong sense of voice: able to write and edit in a consistent, appropriate tone and style.
* Ability to deal with ambiguity: works effectively from incomplete, conflicting, or multi-source information and knows when to escalate.
* General product knowledge: comfortable learning new product context quickly; deep expertise in any single product is not required at entry.
* Works successfully in a team environment and understands team member roles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to AI-assisted content tools or workflows.
* Familiarity with knowledge maps or other structured-content models.
* Basic content or data analytics skills.
* Experience with DITA or other structured-authoring frameworks.
* Experience working in a component content management system (CCMS).
* Broader content creation experience (e.g., digital, consumer-facing, or SEO-oriented content).
* Strong product knowledge in a strategic product area.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
  
  
Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
  
  
More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

title: Senior Content Specialist
description:
**Description**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The position is a non-supervisory position in our Digital Marketing team. This position is responsible for creating and/or customizing content for marketing assets like emails, advertisements, social media posts, infographics, flyers, brochures, presentations, etc. This position will work closely with other members of the digital marketing team, business units, internal graphic designers and communication team, regional colleagues, freelance graphic designers and agencies.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Content Specialist Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Content Development & Optimization - Develop, write, and refine high-quality content for digital marketing assets including emails, landing/webpages, campaign materials, and ecommerce/product content. Ensure all content is aligned with campaign messaging, audience needs, and brand voice. Optimize content for discoverability and engagement across digital channels using best practices in content structuring and search optimization.
* Ecommerce Content & Product Experience - Develop and maintain ecommerce and product-focused content that supports product discovery, understanding, and conversion.Create clear, structured, and informative product descriptions, value propositions, and supporting content aligned with user intent and business objectives. Ensure consistency and accuracy across product content, and optimize content presentation for usability and digital experience.
* Campaign Content Execution - Execute content requirements for planned campaigns and ad-hoc initiatives based on defined briefs and timelines. Work closely with campaign managers and content strategy lead to translate requirements into clear, accurate, and effective content deliverables. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely delivery across all assigned tasks.
* Content Reusability & Asset Management - Develop content in a modular and reusable format to support scalability across campaigns and channels. Contribute to and leverage structured content repositories, ensuring proper organization, version control, and alignment with content standards. Identify opportunities to reuse and adapt existing content.
* Organic Content & Channel Support – Support the development and execution of content for organic channels such as LinkedIn, Facebook, and thought leadership initiatives. Adapt content formats and messaging for different platforms while maintaining consistency with overall campaign objectives.
* Content Optimization & Continuous Improvement - Review and refine content based on feedback, stakeholder inputs, and performance insights (where available). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve content effectiveness, clarity, and audience engagement over time.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Example**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in digital content creation or ecommerce content
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or scientific content domains
* Strong understanding of SEO/GEO/AEO fundamentals and content optimization for digital discovery
* Experience writing for multiple formats including campaign content, emails, landing pages, and ecommerce/product content
* Ability to interpret briefs and translate them into structured, high-quality content with minimal iterations
* Familiarity with content reuse, modular content approaches, and content management systems
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to assess content performance and optimize accordingly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables and work collaboratively across teams with minimal supervision

**Additional Desired Preferences**
Desired preferences include highlighting any additional preferred levels of expertise for the role—reminder: items listed here are not requirements and do not disqualify a candidate from consideration.
  
  

* Exposure to ecommerce content optimization and product-led storytelling
* Experience working with AI-assisted content tools (e.g., content generation, translation, or optimization tools)
* Familiarity with analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, SEO tools like SEMrush, etc.)
* Experience working within agency or cross-functional marketing environments

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
**Job Category**
Sales & Marketing
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

title: Risk Platforms-EGRC-Workiva-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY - GDS Consulting**
–
**GRC Technology – EnterpriseGRC – Workiva - Senior**
As EY GDS Consulting Senior, you’ll contribute technically to GRC Technology client engagements and internal projects. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for GRC Professionals with expertise in Workiva Platform and Workiva GRC solutions to join our international network of GRC Technology professionals helping clients implement technology solutions that support governance, risk management, compliance, internal controls, audit, and regulatory reporting. The individual will assist GRC Leads and Solution Architects in designing Workiva-based solutions, creating proof of concepts, assessing technology feasibility, and implementing scalable GRC and compliance programs.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a leading consulting practice while playing a key role in expanding our Workiva service offerings globally.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and client stakeholders to understand business requirements and design optimal Workiva solutions.
* Map customer requirements to Workiva capabilities and recommend leading practices for GRC, Internal Audit, SOX Compliance, ESG Reporting, and Regulatory Compliance programs.
* Configure and implement Workiva solutions including:
* SOX/Internal Controls Management
* Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
* Internal Audit Management
* Compliance Management
* ESG Reporting
* Regulatory Reporting
* Third-Party Risk Management
* Policy Management
* Design Workiva data models, reporting structures, workflows, and user experiences to support business processes.
* Configure Workiva workflows, task management, certifications, issue management, risk registers, controls, testing programs, and reporting dashboards.
* Drive automation, standardization, and process optimization across risk and compliance functions.
* Develop and maintain Workiva reports, linked documents, dashboards, questionnaires, assessments, and analytics solutions.
* Collaborate with client and technical teams to integrate Workiva with ERP, HR, Identity Management, and other enterprise systems.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including user story refinement, effort estimation, and sprint planning.
* Conduct requirements workshops, solution demonstrations, showback sessions, UAT support, and knowledge transfer sessions.
* Perform testing, quality assurance, and defect resolution activities.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to project teams and mentor junior resources.
* Stay current with Workiva platform enhancements, GRC trends, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.
* Assist regional teams in RFP responses, solution proposals, effort estimations, and client presentations.
* Develop and maintain productive client relationships and contribute to customer success.
* Ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks while adhering to project quality standards and organizational policies.
* Support project leadership in planning, estimation, delivery governance, and stakeholder management activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and workshop facilitation skills.
* Ability to translate complex risk and compliance requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience creating solution design documents, process flows, and implementation artifacts.
* Ability to work effectively within cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a strong quality culture.
* Ability to mentor team members and support capability-building initiatives.

**To qualify for the role, you must have-**

* 3 to 8+ years of relevant experience in GRC, Internal Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, or Governance Technology implementations.
* Experience working on 3 to 5 end-to-end Workiva implementation engagements.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
* Workiva Internal Controls Management (SOX)
* Workiva Risk Management
* Workiva Internal Audit Management
* Workiva Compliance Programs
* ESG Reporting
* Regulatory Reporting
* Strong understanding of:
* SOX Compliance
* Internal Controls Frameworks
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Internal Audit Processes
* Regulatory Compliance
* Information Security Governance
* Experience facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, configuring solutions, and supporting UAT.
* Experience creating and maintaining functional and technical documentation.
* Working knowledge of reporting, dashboarding, workflow design, and data management within Workiva.
* Experience in client-facing consulting engagements and stakeholder management.

title: Learning Content Program Coordinator
description:
**Certification Program/LMS (Learning Systems) Content Coordinator| Hyderabad or Pune | Hybrid**

**About Cornerstone**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

**About the Role**

The Certification Program Coordinator supports the day-to-day operational and administrative work of the Cornerstone Certification Program, including certification asset creation and maintenance, LMS content administration, revenue operations support, and customer-facing certification support. You help give candidates, customers, partners, and employees a high-quality certification experience. As the program expands, you will also play a key part in content localization initiatives that are expected to significantly increase the number of assets to manage.

**In This Role You Will**

* Create, update, and maintain candidate-facing certification support materials, including study guides, exercises, and exam preparation resources, in alignment with exam blueprints and content direction from the Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs).
* Manage learner-facing content structure and administration within the LMS, ensuring certification content is accurately configured, accessible, and delivers a positive candidate experience.
* Support revenue operations activities related to partner and customer program requirements, ensuring certification offerings are accurately represented and operationally sound.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for certification-related inquiries from customers, partners, and employees, resolving issues efficiently and escalating complex cases as appropriate.
* Own candidate-facing communications for all certification program changes, including new credential launches, exam retirements, version updates, and grandfathering policies
* Draft and distribute announcements across all active candidate channels: Cornerstone Community, email, ServiceNow, Cornerstone U, and Galaxy, ensuring every channel is updated simultaneously and no channel is missed
* Maintain a communications calendar aligned to the product release schedule so candidates receive advance notice before changes take effect
* Partner with the Certification Team Lead to ensure change communications are approved, accurate, and consistent with program branding before distribution
* Coordinate localization of candidate-facing materials into all required languages; manage machine translation workflows and oversee human post-editing to ensure accuracy and consistency before publication
* Maintain accurate records and documentation related to content administration, asset management, and support workflows.
* Partner with the Certification Platforms Specialist, the Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs), and the broader team to ensure operational activities support program goals and deliver a seamless certification experience.
* Build and maintain a library of knowledge articles covering common candidate inquiries (exam eligibility, scheduling, results, renewals, voucher redemption); use AI-assisted authoring tools to draft and update articles and configure automated responses that deflect routine tickets without human intervention.
* Monitor self-service deflection rates and update the knowledge base when new inquiry types emerge or program content changes.
* Identify, test, and implement AI-enabled automation for routine operational work; measure impact and retire unnecessary manual processes.
* Draft status emails, record updates, and standard responses with AI assistance, with human review before anything reaches a customer or partner and recommend retiring manual steps once automation is in place.
* Continuously maps the routine and repeatable tasks within this role, identifies automation opportunities using AI and workflow tools, proposes and implements solutions, and measures whether the automation delivers the expected time and quality improvement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Support responsiveness: First response to certification inquiries within 1 business day and 85% resolved within 3 business days.
* Content currency: 100% of candidate-facing materials aligned to the current product within 3 weeks of each major Cornerstone release.
* Record accuracy: Certification program and content administration records at 99% or higher accuracy, with errors corrected within 5 business days.
* Coordinate localization of candidate-facing materials into all required languages; manage machine translation workflows and oversee human post-editing to ensure accuracy and consistency before publication.
* AI transformation: Baseline hours spent on status emails, record updates, and standard responses measured in the first 90 days, then reduced by 30% within 12 months, with review controls maintained.
* Voucher redemption accuracy: 100% of redeemed vouchers reconcile to the correct partner tier and exam record with zero revenue discrepancy per reporting period.
* All candidate-facing channels (Community, email, ServiceNow, Cornerstone U, Galaxy) are updated within a maximum of 1 business day of any program change, with no channel more than 3 days behind any other.

**You Have Got What it Takes, If you Have**

* Experience with LMS content administration and learner-facing content management.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing program assets and documentation.
* Experience in customer or partner-facing support roles.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.
* Ability to evaluate AI outputs and apply sound judgment about when a human must decide.
* Experience managing communications across multiple digital channels (email, community platforms, support portals, learning portals).
* Experience with localization workflows including machine translation tools and human post-editing processes; able to assess translation quality without necessarily being fluent in the target language.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with revenue operations processes or program administration.
* Experience with content localization or translation coordination.
* Experience using AI or workflow tools to automate routine administrative work.

**AI & Continuous Learning**

* Identifies routine administrative and support tasks (status emails, record updates, standard responses) that AI can handle and retires manual steps once automation is in place.
* Uses AI tools every day in their own work and can show an example where AI changed how the work is done, not just how fast.
* Evaluates AI output critically for accuracy, bias, privacy and data handling, and knows when a human must decide.
* Actively explores internal (Cornerstone AI) and external tools, brings recommendations to the team, and retires tools and processes that do not earn their place.
* Keeps skills current through communities, certifications, hands-on experimentation and industry learning, and shares what they learn with the team.

**How You Work**

* Customer obsessed: Start with the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* Innovate and transform: Challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that do not earn their place.
* Proactive leadership: See problems and act before being asked.
* Get it done: Ship, measure and iterate.
* Forward looking: Plan for where technology and the business are going.
* AI native: Use AI daily to rethink work, not just accelerate it.
* Get uncomfortable to succeed: Take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

title: Systems Engineering Lead
description:
**Role and Responsibilities:**

**analytical skills, and**

The Adaptive and Embedded Computing Group (AECG) — Application Engineering group, located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, for an experienced engineer to focus on hardware emulation platforms, FPGA prototyping methodologies, design enablement flows, tools specification, validation, documentation, and key customer support. * Develop and deliver training materials on new emulation/prototyping features, platforms, and methodologies.

Scripting experience (Tcl, Perl, Python) is desired.
* Design Enablement: Has good understanding of design methodologies for Emulation & Prototyping flows
* Problem Solving: Ability to handle and solve complex system-level issues across emulation, prototyping, and pre-silicon validation environments.

title: Senior GIS Test Engineer
description:
**About Us**
TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.
  
  
TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.
  
  
We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
  
  
**Overview**
The Senior Test Engineer will be responsible for hands-on quality assurance and testing of GIS applications and data workflows, ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and performance of Esri-based solutions. This role focuses on detailed test planning, preparing test scripts and scenarios, executing system, integration, regression, and performance tests, and producing clear test reports for GIS projects in the utilities domain.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop test plans, test cases, and test strategies for GIS applications and data workflows.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, performance, and end-to-end testing for Esri-based solutions (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcFM, Utility Network).
* Validate GIS data integrity, spatial accuracy, topology rules, and workflow configurations.
* Create and maintain automated test scripts using Python (ArcPy) for workflow and data validation.
* Use FME or similar ETL tools to validate data migration, transformation, and system integrations.
* Track test execution, manage defects, and prepare test reports using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail.
* Collaborate with developers, GIS analysts, data engineers, and business teams to resolve issues and verify fixes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to quality improvements, test automation, and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* 6-8 years of software testing experience with strong GIS testing expertise.
* Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and preferably ArcFM and Utility Network.
* Experience with utility network models and GIS data workflows in Electric, Gas, Water, or Telecom domains.
* Experience with Python (ArcPy) for automation and data validation.
* Working knowledge of FME or similar data transformation/validation tools.
* Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, performance, and data validation testing.
* Experience with testing tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Postman, JMeter, or similar.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and Agile collaboration skills.

title: Content Lead - Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
**Role Summary**

As a Content Lead for Forward Deployed Engineering, you'll own the entire learning journey that prepares students to work as engineers embedded with customers: taking a vague business problem, scoping it, building a working solution on real systems and messy data, and getting it adopted. That includes designing the curriculum, writing reading materials, building assessments, creating lab exercises, and developing projects that mirror real customer engagements.

This is a hands-on creation role. You'll spend most of your time building, testing, and improving content. You'll also be running mock engagements and building customer-style solutions yourself, because this work is learned from doing it under ambiguity, and content written by someone who hasn't sat with a customer shows. If you can't do it, you can't teach it.

If you're someone who can take a half-formed problem statement, turn it into a scoped build, ship a working integration against messy data, and then explain both the technical choices and the customer conversation clearly enough that a student gets it, this is your role.

**What You Will Do**

* Design semester-wise curriculum and decide how topics are structured, sequenced, and paced across the academic calendar, from technical foundations to full engagement simulations.
* Keep the content aligned with what the industry hires for. Map topics to real roles such as forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, implementation engineer, and technical consultant.
* Continuously evolve the content strategy based on what's working, what's not, and how the role is changing as AI platforms and enterprise tooling evolve.
* Write clear, in-depth reading materials that students can learn from independently. Not job-description summaries or buzzword overviews, but well-structured explanations with realistic scenarios, working examples, and the reasoning behind each decision.
* Design problems that test judgment as well as code, such as scoping an ambiguous request, choosing between a quick fix and a proper build, debugging an integration, or deciding what to tell a stakeholder.
* Build question banks following ByteXL's quality standards for difficulty distribution, answer balance, and auto-gradability.
* Create hands-on lab exercises that progressively build complexity, from API integration, data cleaning, and SQL to building and deploying a working solution against a realistic customer environment.
* Design capstone projects that simulate a full engagement: requirements discovery, scoping, build, deployment, documentation, and handoff, with deliberately messy data, shifting requirements, and legacy systems.
* Build the sample engagements yourself regularly to confirm they're doable, realistic, and teach the intended lessons.
* Teach the non-code skills as part of the technical work, including requirements gathering, written updates, demos, expectation setting, and writing documentation that a customer's team can use.
* Stay current with the tools, platforms, and practices forward deployed teams use, and decide what is worth teaching.
* Try new ways of teaching and building content. If something could work better, prototype it and make the case.

**What We're Looking For**

*Must Have*

* B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
* 3-5 years of hands-on engineering experience, including at least 2 years working directly with customers or internal stakeholders on problems that weren't fully specified. Titles vary (forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, implementation engineer, technical consultant), so we care about what you did, not what you were called.
* Has taken at least one solution from a vague request to production and stayed through adoption. You scoped it, built it, deployed it, and dealt with what broke afterward.
* Strong Python, with working fluency in TypeScript or JavaScript, and the ability to read unfamiliar and legacy code quickly.
* Strong SQL, and has cleaned, reconciled, and made sense of data that was incomplete, inconsistent, or documented wrongly.
* Has built integrations against real third-party or legacy systems, including REST APIs, webhooks, auth flows, rate limits, retries, and failure handling.
* Can deploy and debug your own work using Git, Docker, a major cloud platform, CI/CD, and logs and monitoring. You can tell why something works locally and fails in production.
* Has built with LLM APIs in a real solution, covering prompting, structured outputs, retrieval, and basic evaluation. You also know when an LLM is the wrong tool.
* Has written for or presented to non-technical stakeholders, such as scoping documents, status updates, demos, or handover documentation that a customer's team actually used. You'll be asked to share a sample.
* Has mentored, trained, onboarded, or written technical content for others, and can show something you wrote or taught.
* Can build realistic practice environments such as mock customer systems, messy datasets, and ambiguous briefs. These need to be safe for students to work in and still assessable fairly.
* Can explain how you'd scope a vague request, or why an integration that passed testing fails in production, clearly enough that a second-year student follows the reasoning, not just the answer.
* Works independently without needing constant direction.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience on a forward deployed or solutions team at a startup or platform company.
* Experience with enterprise systems such as CRMs, ERPs, data warehouses, and BI tools.
* Depth in an industry vertical such as banking, healthcare, manufacturing, or logistics.
* Experience with access control, security, and compliance in customer deployments.
* Experience designing scenario-based assessments or grading rubrics.
* Public writing, open-source work, or conference talks about applied engineering.

**MODE:**
Hybrid

description:

title: Data & Automations Analyst
description:
**Data & Automations Analyst – SiliconPath Law**

**Role overview**

The Data & Automations Analyst finds the repeatable work in SiliconPath Law’s case workflow and makes it faster, more accurate, and safer using AI and automation. They also give leadership a clear, live view of how the firm is performing. This person builds tools and dashboards that case managers, immigration specialists, content writers, paralegals, attorneys, and leadership use every day.

**Core responsibilities**

* **Workflow automation:**
  Automate handoffs, reminders, and routine messages in our case management system, such as welcome emails, document requests, and recommender follow-ups.
* **Document checks:**
  Build tools that flag missing, illegible, outdated, or inconsistent documents before the immigration specialist reviews them.
* **Drafting support:**
  Create and maintain AI prompts, templates, and workflows for first drafts of letters of recommendation (LORs), personal statements, and petition sections, with built-in checks that every number and date matches the evidence.
* **Reporting:**
  Automate the weekly client progress reports, attorney case summaries, and the progress tracker.
* **Dashboards and analytics:**
  Build and maintain dashboards that give leadership a live view of the firm, including the case pipeline and stages, turnaround times, document and signature delays, team capacity against role ratios, role KPIs, and Request for Evidence (RFE) trends.
* **Responsible AI and data protection:**
  Ensure every AI tool the team uses protects client data, and set and maintain SPL’s guidelines for safe AI use.
* **Training and adoption:**
  Train the team on new tools, gather feedback, and keep improving what’s been built.
* **Measuring impact:**
  Track time saved, error rates, and adoption for every tool, and report the results to leadership.

**What we look for**

* **Process analysis:**
  You can map a messy workflow and spot exactly where automation will help most.
* **AI implementation:**
  You know how to get reliable, accurate results from AI tools, and how to test them.
* **Automation building:**
  You build working automations and integrations, not just recommend them.
* **Data and reporting:**
  You turn raw data into clear dashboards and reports that help people make decisions.

**Key skills**

* Google Apps Script and JavaScript
* No-code or low-code automation tools (for example, Zapier, Make, or n8n)
* Working with APIs and integrations
* Using large language models (LLMs) and writing effective prompts
* Building dashboards in a BI tool (for example, Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau)
* Data privacy and security basics

**Nice to have:**
Python, SQL, and experience in legal tech or professional services.

title: ITAM Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ITAM Operations & Automation Specialist to sit at the intersection of process engineering and automation. This is a critical role that spans our entire managed IT operations engagement, providing you with the scope to influence and improve processes beyond a single service line.
  
  
You will deep-dive into complex operational workflows—particularly within the hardware asset lifecycle, including dock-to-stock receiving, imaging, depot staging, redeployment, reverse logistics, and disposal. You will be responsible for documenting these processes, then building the automations, data pipelines, and dashboards that make them measurable, efficient, and cost-effective.
  
  
What makes this role distinctive is the ability to own the full lifecycle of improvement: the same person who maps the process also writes the script to eliminate manual steps. This approach ensures that improvements do not stall in the gap between operations teams identifying a problem and development teams working to fix it.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Unique**
Engagement-Wide Impact: You will work across diverse service lines, building the influence needed to implement meaningful change.
  
  
Strategic Migration Ownership: You will guide us through a critical platform migration by authoring as-is and future-state workflows, ensuring consistency across parallel systems.
  
  
Design Authority: You will serve as the advocate for enhancement and defect requests within our change governance, using data-driven evidence to prioritize critical improvements.
  
  
Build for Sustainability: We are looking for an engineering mindset that builds solutions that are well-documented and scalable, ensuring they can be managed and sustained by the team rather than only by their author.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Process Deep-Dives, Workflows & Documentation

Analyse and optimize complex operational workflows across the engagement's service lines, going deepest on the asset lifecycle: dock-to-stock receiving, imaging, depot staging, redeployment, reverse logistics and disposal.
  
  
Work across service lines the role does not own, building the access and credibility needed to change how another team operates.
  
  
Author, maintain and audit standard operating procedures, field operations playbook articles and knowledge base guides, each carrying a revision date and a named owner so currency is verifiable rather than assumed.
  
  
Document as-is and future-state process flows for forward and reverse supply chain logistics to support the platform migration, and maintain both procedure sets for as long as the two platforms run in parallel.
  
  
Draft and distribute global operations communications so regional technicians and operations leads receive process, policy and tool changes before those changes reach them in production.
  
  
Design out the cross-team defect loops — where a data error created by one team surfaces as a fault in another — rather than documenting the workaround and moving on.
  
  
Run root-cause analysis on process failures and close the finding back into the procedure.
  
  

* Data Pipelines, Dashboards & Analytics

Build and maintain operational and executive dashboards covering live asset inventory and tier reporting, third-party logistics and reseller inventory positions, and service level and performance scorecards.
  
  
Design, validate and maintain the data sources connecting internal databases, spreadsheet repositories and ERP feeds, so reporting is genuinely current rather than reconstructed monthly.
  
  
Own data quality at source: identify and resolve systemic anomalies such as pending-hardware order misclassification, inventory discrepancies and vendor serial-number format inconsistencies.
  
  
Produce turnaround-time and bottleneck analysis across the asset and part-creation path, so delays can be escalated with evidence and attributed to the step that causes them.
  
  
Guard against tooling-induced regressions, where correcting one data set breaks another, by validating downstream impact before and after every change.
  
  
Build reporting that answers a decision, and retire dashboards nobody uses.
  
  

* Custom Tooling & Automation

Develop, debug and enhance custom automation using Apps Script and comparable JavaScript scripting with REST API integration — form-to-ticket automation, bulk ticket generation and update, and data validation routines.
  
  
Support and maintain internal browser-based extensions and utility applications, including label printing utilities for thermal and desktop label printers, rapid asset lookup, and encryption-status verification.
  
  
Maintain the internal tool registry, triage incoming bug reports, and prioritise enhancements on operational return rather than on who asked loudest.
  
  
Apply an automation threshold: where a manual process crosses the agreed annual transaction volume, raise a requirements document and move it onto scripted or robotic handling.
  
  
Build for handover — documented, owned by the function rather than an individual account, and recoverable if the author is unavailable.
  
  
Retire and decommission tooling cleanly when the process it supports changes.
  
  

* Programme Management & Portfolio Tracking

Manage project and portfolio boards and their Kanban cadences, keeping tasks, milestones and deliverables current within the agreed review cadence.
  
  
Track, measure and report quantifiable operational improvement — cost avoidance, labour-hour reduction and throughput gain — with the baseline captured before the change, not estimated after it.
  
  
Represent operations in change and release governance, carrying enhancement and defect requests through to a scheduled fix and holding the case for those that would otherwise sit at low priority indefinitely.
  
  
Manage ad-hoc technical requests and escalations across the enterprise ticketing and issue-tracking queues.
  
  
Report programme status and benefit realisation to operations and client leadership, surfacing slippage early rather than at the milestone.
  
  

* Legal Hold & Lifecycle Compliance

Own the legal hold lifecycle operationally: data extraction, verification, ticket generation and chain-of-custody tracking for assets placed under or released from hold.
  
  
Maintain audit-ready records for high-sensitivity cases, including root-cause logs where a hold was delayed, breached or incorrectly released.
  
  
Partner with external e-waste and recycling vendors on pickup manifests, verification of device data sanitisation and encryption, and reconciliation of recycling returns against what was collected.
  
  
Verify disposal against recognised data-sanitisation standards and retain the certificates of destruction the audit trail depends on.
  
  
Support internal and external audit requests with complete, retrievable evidence rather than reconstructed narrative.
  
  

* ITAM Operations Management

Own IT Asset lifecycle operationally: data extraction, verification, ticket generation and chain of custody tracking for assets under team management.
  
  
Maintain audit-ready records, including root-cause logs for issues and risk analysis for upcoming initiatives.
  
  
Partner with external vendors for processes including e-waste and recycling, legal, supply chain and receiving, and technical support on process improvements, standardizations, data verification.
  
  
Support internal and external audit requests with complete, retrievable evidence rather than reconstructed narrative.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS**
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
  
  
Documentation Currency: 100% of in-scope procedures and playbook articles reviewed on the agreed cycle, each with a revision date and named owner.
  
  
Migration Parity: process documentation and procedures consistent across both platforms throughout the migration, with drift detected and corrected rather than discovered.
  
  
Dashboard Reliability: dashboards and data sources refreshed to schedule, with feed failures detected and fixed before the reporting deadline.
  
  
Data Accuracy: sustain ≥99% accuracy on the asset and inventory fields feeding published reporting.
  
  
Automation Delivery: deliver the agreed number of automations each year, each with a measured labour-hour or cost saving attached.
  
  
Continuous Improvement: benefit quantified against a pre-change baseline and reported, with cost avoidance evidenced rather than asserted.
  
  
Portfolio Cadence: 100% of active projects and milestones updated within the agreed 7-day cadence.
  
  
Legal Hold Integrity: 100% chain-of-custody completeness for assets under hold, with zero unrecorded movements.
  
  
Disposal Compliance: 100% of disposal batches reconciled, with sanitisation verified and certificates retained.
  
  
Ticket Quality: sustain ≥95% against the weighted quality scorecard, which is weighted toward technical accuracy, then completeness, timeliness and communication.
  
  
**TOOLS & SYSTEMS**
Service management and asset platforms: ServiceNow for IT service management and hardware and software asset management, alongside the incumbent platforms being migrated from.
  
  
ERP and inventory: SAP for material, inventory and order records, plus warehouse and third-party logistics portals.
  
  
Automation and development: Apps Script and JavaScript, REST API integration, and lightweight browser extension development in JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
  
  
Analytics and business intelligence: SQL and a cloud data warehouse, BI and dashboarding platforms, and advanced spreadsheet data modelling.
  
  
Programme and ticketing: Jira for portfolio and project tracking, plus the enterprise ticketing and issue-tracking queues.
  
  
Documentation: knowledge base tooling, process mapping and flowcharting applications.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
Mandatory
  
  
5–8+ years in IT asset management, hardware lifecycle operations, supply chain operations or business process automation.
  
  
Demonstrated process engineering: process mapping, flowchart development, root-cause analysis, and authoring technical procedures that other people can actually follow.
  
  
Hands-on development of automations and custom tools using Apps Script or comparable JavaScript scripting, with REST API integration.
  
  
Proficiency with SQL and a cloud data warehouse, plus BI and dashboarding platforms and advanced spreadsheet data modelling.
  
  
Working knowledge of enterprise ERP and inventory platforms (SAP, Oracle or equivalent) and of enterprise ticketing and issue-tracking systems.
  
  
Experience documenting and transitioning operational workflows through a platform migration, including maintaining two procedure sets in parallel.
  
  
Excellent written and spoken English for working with globally distributed technicians, operations leads and client stakeholders.
  
  
**Preferred**
Direct ServiceNow experience configuring, documenting or transitioning asset and supply chain workflows, particularly IT and hardware asset management modules.
  
  
Browser extension development in JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
  
  
IT hardware compliance background covering legal holds, data-sanitisation standards and e-waste or recycling certification schemes.
  
  
Robotic process automation exposure, and experience building the business case for automation on operational return.
  
  
Lean, Six Sigma or comparable continuous-improvement certification.
  
  
Experience representing an operations function in a change advisory or release governance forum.
  
  
IT asset management certification such as IAITAM or ITIL.
  
  
**LEVELS & PROGRESSION**
Indicative single seat at Level IV. Note that Level IV elsewhere in this service line denotes a team or shift lead; this role is a senior individual contributor and subject-matter expert with design authority rather than people management.
  
  
Level III — executes process documentation and operational reporting to established patterns, and maintains existing automations and dashboards under guidance.
  
  
Level IV — this role. The design authority for process and tooling in the function: owns the migration documentation set, builds and hands over automations, holds the evidence base, carries the enhancement agenda into change governance, and coaches the levels below.
  
  
Progression — onward into programme management across the wider asset lifecycle estate, or along a specialist automation and analytics track.

title: Senior / Medical Writer
description:
**Who We Are:**

MIMS is Asia-Pacific’s leading multi-channel provider of trusted, quality medical information, medical education, and knowledge services connecting healthcare communities. Our work empowers healthcare professionals to improve patient outcomes by facilitating knowledge exchange and better decision-making.

Today, MIMS has a strong regional presence in 17 countries and regions across Asia-Pacific with approximately two million healthcare professionals subscribed to its drug & resource portal, digital and print publications. We provide solutions to leading pharmaceutical companies and established healthcare institutions across the world.

**Who We Are Looking For:**

Reporting to the editorial lead, the Medical Writer will develop high-quality scientific publications and associated outputs for MIMS MedComms clients. This role is focused on peer-reviewed manuscripts, congress abstracts, posters, oral presentation materials, publication-enhancement content, and related scientific communications. The role is suited to a medical writer with at least 1 year of existing publications writing experience who wants to build deeper expertise in ethical, accurate, and transparent medical publication practice while working with experienced editorial and client teams.

Given the high volume of writers needed, freelancers are also welcome to apply.

**What Impact You Will Make:**

* Develop scientifically accurate, well-structured publication content for peer-reviewed journals and congresses, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, oral presentation materials, plain language summaries, and publication-related slide content.
* Work from clinical data, literature, author direction, and client briefs to prepare clear publication drafts that communicate evidence accurately and appropriately for specialist medical audiences.
* Support publication development in line with established industry standards, including Good Publication Practice, ICMJE authorship and disclosure expectations, and relevant reporting guidelines such as CONSORT and other EQUATOR Network resources where applicable.
* Conduct targeted literature reviews, reference checks, data extraction, fact checking, and quality control to ensure scientific accuracy, consistency, and appropriate citation of source material.
* Prepare publication outlines, first drafts, revised drafts, response-to-reviewer content, figure and table legends, and associated submission-ready materials under guidance from senior writers and editorial leads.
* Coordinate comments from authors, clients, reviewers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring revisions are addressed clearly, accurately, and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain awareness of journal and congress requirements, including formatting, word count, referencing, disclosure, acknowledgements, and submission requirements.
* Collaborate professionally with authors, key opinion leaders, clients, project managers, medical editors, and account teams to support efficient and ethical publication delivery.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing by building therapy area familiarity, applying editorial feedback, and developing stronger publication-writing judgement over time.

**What Skills and Experience You Will Bring:**

* Graduate degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, public health, biomedical sciences, or a related scientific discipline; a higher degree is advantageous but not essential.
* At least 1 year of existing experience writing or substantially contributing to peer-reviewed medical or scientific publications, ideally within a medical communications agency, publisher, CRO, pharmaceutical company, academic, or healthcare research environment.
* Candidates possessing over 4 years of experience will be evaluated for the Senior Medical Writer position.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, accurate scientific content for publication outputs such as manuscripts, abstracts, posters, congress presentations, literature reviews, or plain language summaries.
* Working knowledge of publication ethics and industry expectations, including transparency, appropriate acknowledgement of medical writing support, authorship principles, disclosure requirements, and accurate reporting of data.
* Ability to interpret clinical and scientific information, identify the key message, and present complex data in a concise and balanced way for healthcare professional audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, including referencing accuracy, consistency checking, data verification, formatting, grammar, and adherence to client, journal, and internal style requirements.
* Good project discipline, with the ability to manage assigned writing tasks, respond constructively to feedback, and meet agreed timelines across multiple publication deliverables.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office; familiarity with reference management tools, publication databases, and journal submission systems would be advantageous.

**Key Behaviours**

* Scientifically curious, with a genuine interest in communicating research clearly and responsibly.
* Ethical and quality-focused, with respect for publication standards, author accountability, data integrity, and transparency.
* Collaborative and responsive, able to work constructively with authors, clients, senior writers, editors, and project teams.
* Organised and accountable, with the ability to manage detail while keeping publication milestones on track.
* Open to feedback and committed to continuous development as a publications medical writer.
* Positive, proactive, and able to contribute to a supportive regional/global MedComms team environment.

title: Principal Expert, US Insurance Industry
description:
**Life at UiPath**
The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
  
  
To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
  
  
Could that be you?
  
  
**Your Mission**
UiPath is building a new way to design and deliver enterprise processes. UiPath cartographer draws on a curated library of industry process knowledge, interviews the business, and produces process maps and design documents. AI coding agents then turn those designs into working, orchestrated solutions, in days rather than months.
  
  
In insurance, "almost right" isn't good enough. The best AI companies in regulated industries have learned the same lesson: quality comes from making a senior practitioner part of the team to building the benchmarks, evaluations and feedback loops around their experience and judgment.
  
  
That's this role. As our Principal Expert for insurance, you will own the quality of everything our AI produces for US insurers. You'll set the bar, build the tests that hold the AI to it, and work in the field with customers and partners to make sure what we ship works in a real carrier.
  
  
This role does not carry a sales quota and is not a product management role. Success is measured by the quality of the insurance solutions we deliver and how confidently customers build on them.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Exciting**

* Your work sets the standard. What you define as good will be used by insurance customers, partners and AI agents across the platform.
* You see the impact. Take a process from discovery to a working solution in days, then keep improving it.
* You're building something new. Help decide which lines of business we go after next and how we measure the success of AI-designed processes.

**What You'll Do At UiPath**
**Own insurance AI quality**

* Own the quality of insurance process knowledge, designs and solutions across Property & Casualty and Life & Annuity.
* Decide what needs fixing first, review changes before they go to customers, and sign off when a process is ready.
* Work with industry experts, partners and reviewers to maintain and improve quality.

**Build the insurance benchmark**

* Build a library of real insurance use cases covering claims, FNOL and triage, total loss, endorsements, life claims, medical records, disability claims and new business NIGO.
* Define test cases, scoring criteria and expected answers to evaluate every new AI model and product release before it reaches customers.

**Turn expert judgment into evaluations**

* Evaluate AI outputs at every stage, from process knowledge and process maps to design documents and working solutions.
* Work with applied scientists and engineers to make sure automated AI evaluations match expert judgment, so we can scale quality checks without relying on manual reviews for everything.

**Find failures and make sure they get fixed**

* Review actual outputs, identify common failure types across regulation, coverage, workflows, data and terminology, and prioritise them based on customer impact.
* Turn recurring failures into reusable test cases and make sure fixes work before they go live.
* Share clear updates on quality, key issues and progress with leadership, product teams and customers.

**How You'll Work**
You'll work in a small, senior team of automation consultants, engineers and applied scientists, working directly with customers.
  
  

* Work with insurance carriers, MGAs and consulting partners to understand how their claims and underwriting teams operate, and test our designs against real processes.
* Join consultants and engineers on customer deployments and use what you learn to improve our benchmarks and evaluations.
* Run a regular review cycle, roughly every two weeks, to assess outputs, prioritise fixes and track improvements.
* Join customer and partner meetings.

**What You'll Bring To The Team**

* Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in US insurance, ideally starting hands-on in claims and moving into claims operations senior or mid level roles.
* Deep P&C or Life & Annuity knowledge across the lifecycle
* Working knowledge of US claims regulation: unfair claims settlement practices, state acknowledgment and payment deadlines, total-loss and salvage rules, and market conduct exams.
* Experience mapping or redesigning claims or policy servicing operations: queues, handoffs, SLAs, exceptions, fraud referral and QA.
* The confidence to review complex documents quickly, spot what's plausible but wrong, and explain exactly why.

**Nice To Have**

* Life & Annuity or disability expertise: contestability, beneficiary determination, unclaimed property, suitability, and underwriting evidence such as medical records.
* Experience evaluating AI or automation output: writing test cases, rubrics or reference answers, or running QA or validation programs.
* Experience with insurance AI, claims automation or document intake programs.
* Comfort with data and light technical work, such as spreadsheets, data analysis or prompting AI tools.
* Experience leading or calibrating a team of reviewers, auditors or claims QA specialists.
* Commercial lines, workers' compensation, employee benefits or broker/MGA experience.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
  
  
Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
  
  
We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.
