title: Associate IS Engineer
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  
  
This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application
* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.
* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.
* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.
* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.
* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.
* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.
* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.
* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.
* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely
* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.
* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.
* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.
* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.
* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.
* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.
* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.
* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues.
* Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations.
* Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts.
* Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
* Familiarity with React and Vite, Angular, Vue.js, or another modern front-end framework.
* Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI, or a comparable back-end technology.
* Experience developing, testing, debugging, supporting, and deploying software applications.
* Understanding of software-testing methodologies including functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting test results.
* Familiarity with unit and UI testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with defect and work-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment.
* Understanding of secure coding principles, OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, dependency management, and application security.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and external vendors.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to GxP or regulated systems and associated validation/compliance activities.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment.
* Familiarity with IT service-management processes and tools such as ServiceNow.
* Experience working with SaaS and/or vendor-managed enterprise applications.
* Understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-hosted application architectures.
* Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or application observability tools.
* Experience supporting API-based or middleware-based system integrations.
* Exposure to application lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, upgrades, patching, and technical-debt remediation.
* Experience working in cross-functional teams involving business stakeholders, vendors, infrastructure, security, and application-development teams.

**Ready to Apply for the Job?**
We highly recommend utilizing Workday's robust Career Profile feature to complete the application process. A link to update your profile is available when you click Apply. You can then complete your Workday profile in minutes with the “Upload My Experience” functionality to upload an updated copy of your resume, or you can simply edit the individual sections of your Career Profile.

title: Copy of Lead, QA
description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines.
  
  
Website: https://ayr.energy
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own in-process quality for medium and power transformers (33–400 kV), ensuring products meet applicable standards, customer specifications, and Ayr Energy's Quality Management System (QMS). Lead stage-wise quality controls across core, coil, tanking, assembly, oil processing, and final tests to achieve first-time-right builds, reduce rework, and elevate
  
  
customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality System & Documentation
* Create and maintain Control Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), stage checklists, work instructions, and traveler/route cards; enforce hold/witness points.
* Own NCR/CAPA—facilitate structured root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), implement fixes, and verify effectiveness; drive defect prevention.
* Maintain device history records, test certificates, as-built dossiers, and customer documentation packs for shipment and FAT.
* Supplier & Customer Interface
* Qualify and develop suppliers for critical items (CRGO, copper, bushings, OLTC, radiators, tanks); conduct audits and PPAP/FAI where applicable.
* Lead customer stage and final inspections (FAT), coordinate third-party inspections/test labs, and close observations promptly.
* Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
* Track FPY, rework/repair hours, supplier PPM, test bay failures, and COPQ; publish weekly/monthly dashboards.
* Apply 7 QC tools, MSA (GR&R), process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk), and SPC to stabilize and improve processes.
* Run kaizens to reduce defects (e.g., oil leaks, winding shorts, paint defects) and cycle time at critical stages.

Compliance & Standards
  
  

* ISO 9001:2015 QMS; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 (EHS) – adhere to procedures and participate in audits.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (Electrical preferred).
* Experience: 8–15 years in transformer manufacturing quality; at least 5 years hands-on in-process/stage inspection and test bay exposure for 66 kV+ class.
* Certifications (preferred): Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ CQA/CQE, NDT Level II (VT/PT), Lead Auditor (ISO 9001).

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of transformer construction, drawings (GA, core/coil, schematic), tolerances, and insulation systems.
* Proficiency with electrical tests (TTR, WR, IR/PI, tan δ/PF, SFRA, AC withstand) and interpretation of results.
* Hands-on with metrology and torque tools; ability to set up gauges/fixtures and verify special processes.
* QMS documentation, RCA/CAPA, statistical analysis (MSA, Cp/Cpk), and SPC; working knowledge of ERP/MES and Minitab/Excel.
* Clear written/verbal communication; ability to coach operators, manage audits, and interface with customers and TPI bodies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* First-pass yield at critical stages and final test
* Supplier PPM and on-time NCR closure
* Defect/rework reduction (%), COPQ trend
* Calibration compliance and audit scores
* On-time documentation pack readiness and shipment clearance

**Why Join Ayr Energy**
Be part of a fast-growing grid hardware company building mission-critical products. You will shape world-class manufacturing systems, work with global suppliers and utilities, and grow into leadership roles with clear impact on reliability and safety of power networks.
  
  
**Work Conditions**

* Primarily shop-floor based role with regular presence in test bay and oil processing areas.
* Shift and weekend support during critical builds or customer inspections as needed.
* Travel up to 60% for supplier audits, customer FATs, or type test witnessing.

As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes.

* Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets.

* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

**What We Look For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

title: Proposal Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Business Development & Proposal Manager to lead opportunity identification, market intelligence, bid strategy, and end-to-end proposal management for our U.S. civil engineering and infrastructure business. The role will focus on identifying and qualifying U.S. federal, state, county, and municipal government opportunities; analyzing RFPs and RFQs; developing compliant and competitive proposals; coordinating with technical and commercial teams; and maintaining a strong pipeline of upcoming opportunities.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing U.S. government bids and proposals, a strong understanding of government procurement processes, excellent proposal-writing and analytical skills, and the ability to translate business opportunities into well-structured, competitive submissions.
**Prior hands-on experience supporting or managing U.S. government contracts at both federal and state/local levels is mandatory.**
Experience in civil engineering, infrastructure, construction inspection, geotechnical engineering, or engineering consulting is highly preferred.
  
  

* Business Development & Opportunity Identification
* Identify, research, and qualify new business opportunities across U.S. federal, state, county, and municipal government agencies.
* Monitor government procurement portals, including SAM.gov and state/local procurement platforms, for relevant solicitations.
* Identify opportunities related to civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction materials testing, construction inspection, infrastructure monitoring, and engineering consulting services.
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of upcoming, active, and potential business opportunities.
* Conduct market research to understand client requirements, upcoming projects, procurement trends, and competitor activity.
* Support management in evaluating new markets, target agencies, strategic accounts, and potential partnerships.
* Maintain opportunity trackers and provide regular pipeline updates to leadership.
* Bid Strategy & Opportunity Qualification
* Review and evaluate RFPs, RFQs, Requests for Information (RFIs), Expressions of Interest (EOIs), and other government solicitations.
* Assess solicitation requirements, eligibility criteria, scope of work, evaluation methodology, submission deadlines, and contractual conditions.
* Coordinate bid/no-bid evaluations with leadership and relevant technical and commercial stakeholders.
* Identify proposal requirements, compliance risks, resource needs, and potential differentiators.
* Develop proposal schedules, compliance matrices, responsibility assignments, and submission plans.
* Track amendments, addenda, clarifications, and changes to solicitation requirements.
* End-to-End Proposal & Bid Management
* Lead the complete proposal lifecycle, from opportunity identification and qualification through submission and post-submission follow-up.
* Manage the preparation of technical proposals, management approaches, project understanding, staffing plans, past-performance references, and supporting documentation.
* Develop proposal outlines, response matrices, submission checklists, and compliance documents.
* Coordinate with engineering, project management, operations, finance, legal, and leadership teams to collect proposal inputs.
* Ensure proposals address all solicitation requirements and evaluation criteria.
* Review submissions for accuracy, consistency, completeness, compliance, and overall presentation.
* Manage proposal deadlines and ensure timely submission through the appropriate procurement portals.
* Coordinate post-submission clarifications, interviews, presentations, and follow-up activities.
* Proposal Writing & Content Development
* Develop clear, persuasive, and technically sound proposal narratives aligned with U.S. government solicitation requirements.
* Prepare and refine executive summaries, technical approaches, staffing methodologies, management plans, and project-specific responses.
* Maintain a centralized library of company qualifications, project descriptions, past-performance records, resumes, certifications, and standard proposal content.
* Develop and maintain company capability statements, corporate profiles, and agency-specific qualifications packages.
* Work with subject-matter experts to translate technical information into clear, compliant, client-focused proposals.
* Continuously improve proposal quality, consistency, and competitiveness.
* Commercial & Pricing Coordination
* Coordinate with management, engineering, estimation, and finance teams to develop competitive commercial proposals.
* Review pricing inputs, labor categories, resource requirements, assumptions, and commercial terms.
* Ensure proposed pricing and supporting documentation align with solicitation instructions.
* Identify commercial risks, contractual exceptions, and compliance concerns for management review.
* Support responses to commercial clarifications and post-submission negotiations, where applicable.
* U.S. Government Procurement & Compliance
* Apply practical knowledge of U.S. federal and state/local government procurement processes and solicitation requirements.
* Ensure compliance with proposal instructions, mandatory forms, representations, certifications, and submission procedures.
* Coordinate the collection and maintenance of corporate registrations, insurance documentation, relevant certifications, and other supporting records.
* Track contract requirements, amendments, submission milestones, and procurement-related communications.
* Work with internal stakeholders to identify and address proposal compliance gaps before submission.
* Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
* Research government agencies, procurement forecasts, infrastructure programs, and upcoming engineering projects.
* Analyze competitors, contract awards, incumbent contractors, market positioning, and available business intelligence.
* Identify potential clients and opportunities aligned with the company’s service portfolio.
* Maintain records of bid outcomes and analyze win/loss trends.
* Provide management with insights on market opportunities, competitive positioning, and potential areas for business growth.
* Client & Stakeholder Coordination
* Coordinate with U.S.-based leadership, business development teams, technical personnel, and other stakeholders throughout the bid lifecycle.
* Support client communications, pre-bid meetings, clarification requests, and proposal presentations.
* Develop a clear understanding of client requirements and procurement priorities.
* Support the development of long-term client relationships and strategic partnerships.
* Coordinate with internal teams following contract awards to ensure an effective handover of relevant bid commitments and documentation.
* Reporting & Performance Management
* Maintain accurate records of opportunities, active bids, submissions, awards, and lost opportunities.
* Prepare periodic reports on pipeline value, proposal status, submission deadlines, and bid outcomes.
* Track proposal turnaround time, submission compliance, and win rates.
* Provide regular updates and recommendations to management regarding pipeline development and proposal performance.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Demonstrated hands-on experience with U.S. federal and state/local government bids and proposals.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. government procurement processes and solicitation requirements.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end bid and proposal activities.
* Excellent technical and business proposal-writing skills.
* Strong analytical, research, and opportunity-evaluation capabilities.
* Experience preparing compliance matrices, bid schedules, and proposal response plans.
* Ability to coordinate multiple proposals and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent stakeholder-management, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with U.S.-based teams.

Technical & Software Skills
  
  

* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Hands-on familiarity with SAM.gov and U.S. state, county, and municipal procurement portals.
* Experience with government solicitation documents, proposal templates, and compliance matrices.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, opportunity-tracking tools, and bid/proposal management systems.
* Experience with proposal content libraries and document collaboration tools is preferred.
* Exposure to BOQs, cost estimates, and technical engineering documentation is an advantage.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline preferred.
* A degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or Management may be considered for candidates with substantial relevant experience.
* PMP, proposal management, or relevant professional certifications are an advantage.

**Experience Requirements**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in bid management, proposal management, business development, tendering, or pre-sales.
* Mandatory hands-on experience supporting or managing U.S. government contracts at both federal and state/local levels.
* Experience in civil engineering, infrastructure, construction, geotechnical engineering, or engineering consulting is highly preferred.
* Experience coordinating technical and commercial proposals for professional services or engineering projects is strongly preferred.
* Candidates whose experience is limited to Indian government tenders or non-U.S. private-sector bidding will not meet the mandatory U.S. government contracting requirement.

title: Production Documentation & System Coordinator
description:
**About us**

At Leanwatts, we develop innovative power electronic solutions for electric mobility and energy applications through continuous research, engineering, and manufacturing. Our “Designed and Made in India” approach drives us to build reliable, high-performance products for the future of transportation and energy.

**What is this role about?**

We are looking for a Production Documentation & Systems Coordinator to create and maintain each work order and its complete supporting document pack in Leanwatts systems/ERP and as signed physical records. You will ensure every document required by the customer and our internal process is identified, prepared, tracked, completed, and filed from work-order creation through production, testing, packaging, pre-dispatch inspection, and closure.

You will prepare records using approved plans, information, and templates, keep them current, and ensure every required entry and signature is obtained from the responsible person. You will work with PPC, Production, Quality, Testing, Stores, and the Factory Operations Lead to maintain a complete and traceable record for each work order. The responsible teams perform the operations, checks, and tests and approve their results; this role maintains the documentation and system records supporting that work.

**Primary KPI:**

100% of applicable documents required by the customer and internal process are accounted for on every work order and completed by the required stage. Each document must be at the correct revision, contain the required entries and signatures/approvals, agree with the system record, and be traceable and retrievable in its required physical and digital form. Pending documents must have a named owner and due date and remain visible until resolved; any not-applicable status requires confirmation from the authorised process owner.

**What you will do at Leanwatts**

* **Work-Order Creation & Maintenance:**

  Create work orders in Leanwatts systems/ERP from approved production instructions, with the correct product, quantity, dates, sales-order reference where applicable, and approved BOM/routing references. Prepare the corresponding physical work-order sheet, maintain approved changes, and keep system and paper records aligned.
* **Customer & Internal Document-Pack Requirements:**

  Maintain a document-requirement checklist for each work order, confirming applicable customer/order-specific requirements with Sales and Quality and internal requirements with the process owners. Prepare the current approved templates for line startup, process quality, in-process testing, End-of-Line (EoL) testing, packaging, Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI), and any other required records. Track each document’s revision, owner, required stage, due date, physical/digital location, and completion status.
* **Physical Document Issue & Control:**

  Print and issue the correct document pack before the relevant operation begins. Maintain an issue register showing the work-order number, document references and revisions, recipients, and location. Control replacement copies and revised sheets so the current approved version is identifiable and completed records remain traceable.
* **Entries, Signatures & Stage Follow-Up:**

  Follow each work order through the floor and collect the required entries, actual quantities, dates, test/inspection references, and signatures from the operators, testers, inspectors, and approvers concerned. Check completeness at each stage, return incomplete records to their owners, and escalate missing information or signatures promptly.
* **Leanwatts systems/ERP Records & Evidence:**

  Enter and maintain work-order information and authorised updates from verified source records. Ensure production progress, recorded results, quantities, and document references agree with the physical pack. Maintain signed scans, attachments, or linked records through the approved filing method, and keep each document identifiable against its work order.
* **Traceability & Reconciliation:**

  Reconcile work-order references, item and batch/serial details where applicable, material issue/return records, production quantities, testing records, packaging, and PDI documents. Track associated deviations, rework, retest, and approval records where required. Log mismatches and obtain verified corrections from the responsible teams.
* **Document Completion, Closure & Archive:**

  Reconcile the completed pack against the customer and internal document-requirement checklist. Confirm required records, signatures, approvals, and customer submission copies are complete and consistent; escalate gaps before requesting closure or recording an approved release status. Compile the final signed physical file and digital record, coordinate customer document handover through the responsible team where required, and archive and retrieve records under the approved process.
* **Department Training & Process Support:**

  Train users on their work-order entries, document completion, signatures, update timing, and Leanwatts systems/ERP workflows. Maintain simple approved instructions and examples, provide refresher support, and report recurring documentation problems or system issues to the responsible owner.
* **KPI & Pending-Document Reporting:**

  Maintain a daily tracker showing required versus completed documents for each work order, missing entries/signatures, overdue items, locations, responsible owners, and due dates. Report documentation completeness against the 100% target and escalate gaps to the Factory Operations Lead. Support accurate related sales-order and inventory references and resolve discrepancies affecting work-order traceability.

**Must have requirements****1. Education & Relevant Experience**

* **Education:**

  Diploma or bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, commerce, business administration, computer applications, or a related field; equivalent relevant practical experience may also be considered.
* **Experience:**

  2–3 years of experience in a similar manufacturing documentation, work-order coordination, production documentation, document control, or ERP/MIS support role, with hands-on responsibility for physical records and digital system entries.
* **Practical Ownership:**

  Experience preparing and maintaining work orders or job cards, collecting completed records and signatures, reconciling documents with system entries, and following a document pack through to closure.

**2. Work-Order & Manufacturing Documentation**

* **Document-Pack Knowledge:**

  Familiarity with line startup checklists, process quality records, in-process and EoL testing documents, packaging records, and PDI documents. Ability to translate confirmed customer requirements and internal process requirements into a complete work-order document checklist.
* **Document Control:**

  Ability to maintain document numbers, work-order references, current revisions, issue registers, signed originals, replacement copies, and organised physical and digital archives.

**3. Systems/ERP & Data Accuracy**

You should be comfortable creating and maintaining records in an ERP or operations system and checking them against signed documents throughout the work-order lifecycle.

* **System & Spreadsheet Skills:**

  Working proficiency in ERP/MIS or manufacturing operations software and Excel or Google Sheets for filters, basic formulas, reconciliation, and tracking lists. Ability to learn Leanwatts systems/ERP and its approved workflows.
* **Accuracy & Traceability:**

  Ability to check item codes, quantities, dates, work-order references, batch/serial details, document revisions, and approval status; identify omissions or mismatches; and follow verified corrections through to completion.

**4. Coordination, Training & Record Integrity**

* **Floor Coordination & Follow-Up:**

  Comfortable working with PPC, Production, Testing, Quality, and Stores on the factory floor, obtaining records and signatures on time, maintaining an action list, and escalating overdue items clearly.
* **User Training:**

  Ability to demonstrate the correct way to complete a document or system entry, explain required fields and signatures, and help department users maintain the records consistently.
* **Record Integrity:**

  Maintain factual, legible records and follow the approved correction process. Obtain signatures and test/inspection results from the responsible people, preserve supporting evidence, and record completion or approval only when the required evidence is available.

**5. Preferred Advantages**

* **Relevant Industry Exposure:**

  Experience in electronics, electrical equipment, power electronics, or related manufacturing, working with production travellers, job cards, quality records, test reports, or customer documentation packs.
* **Process Improvements:**

  Experience improving document completeness, reducing missing signatures, organising work-order archives, supporting document retrieval for audits or customer queries, or helping teams adopt digital manufacturing records.

title: Founder's Office Intern (Fundraising and Investor Relations)
description:
Founder's Office – Fundraising & Investor Relations Intern

**Purple Business**

**Website:**
https://purplebusiness.in

**Position:**
Founder's Office – Fundraising & Investor Relations Intern

**Department:**
Founder's Office, Strategy & Finance

**Location:**
Remote

**Work Type:**
Internship | Flexible Working Hours

**Reporting To:**
Supreet Venkata & Likhit Garimella (Founders)

**Compensation:**
No fixed compensation initially, with opportunities for a paid role.

About Purple Business

Purple Business is an emerging AI-powered business growth platform designed to help small businesses grow through intelligent marketing, advertising, customer insights, AI-powered content creation, and business automation.

Our vision is to make sophisticated business growth capabilities accessible to millions of small businesses, helping them attract more customers, improve their marketing, and grow their revenue without depending on complicated software tools or expensive agencies.

As we develop our product and prepare for growth, we're looking for an
**ambitious, analytical, financially curious, and exceptionally proactive Founder's Office – Fundraising & Investor Relations Intern**
to work closely with our founders on fundraising strategy, investor research, pitch decks, financial storytelling, and capital acquisition opportunities.

You'll help identify and pursue funding opportunities across angel investors, venture capital firms, family offices, government grants, crowdfunding platforms, incubators, accelerators, and startup funding programs.

**We're looking for someone who loves numbers, understands business, can build compelling narratives, and has the ambition to help take an early-stage startup to its next level.**

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Fundraising Strategy & Capital Planning

1. Work directly with the founders to understand Purple Business's business model, vision, market opportunity, growth strategy, and financial requirements.
2. Research and recommend appropriate fundraising strategies based on the company's current stage, traction, and funding requirements.
3. Help identify suitable sources of capital, including equity financing, grants, startup programs, and other relevant funding opportunities.
4. Develop fundraising roadmaps with potential funding sources, application deadlines, outreach priorities, and milestones.
5. Research typical funding structures, investment terms, valuations, dilution, and other relevant startup financing concepts.
6. Analyze how different funding scenarios could support product development, hiring, customer acquisition, and business expansion.
7. Help the founders determine what business milestones, traction metrics, and financial evidence are needed to strengthen fundraising readiness.

2. Investor Research & Funding Opportunity Discovery

1. Research and identify relevant
   **angel investors, venture capital firms, family offices, angel networks, and early-stage investment funds**
   .
2. Build a structured database of investors who have demonstrated interest in AI, SaaS, marketing technology, SMB solutions, business automation, and related sectors.
3. Research individual investors' investment theses, portfolio companies, preferred funding stages, typical investment sizes, and geographic preferences.
4. Identify relevant government grants, startup funding schemes, innovation programs, and non-dilutive funding opportunities.
5. Research startup incubators, accelerators, university entrepreneurship programs, and corporate innovation initiatives.
6. Explore appropriate crowdfunding opportunities, including equity-based and community-supported models, subject to applicable regulations and eligibility.
7. Monitor upcoming application windows, pitch competitions, startup challenges, and relevant funding announcements.
8. Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on eligibility, strategic relevance, potential funding, timelines, and likelihood of success.
9. Maintain updated investor databases, funding trackers, and opportunity pipelines.

3. Pitch Deck Creation & Investor Presentations

1. Collaborate with the founders and design team to create compelling, professional, and persuasive investor pitch decks.
2. Develop presentations explaining Purple Business's vision, problem statement, solution, product capabilities, business model, market opportunity, competitive landscape, go-to-market strategy, and funding requirements.
3. Research and prepare supporting data for market sizing, including TAM, SAM, and SOM estimates with clearly documented assumptions.
4. Create visually understandable charts, business metrics, revenue projections, financial models, and investment-related presentations.
5. Develop different versions of the pitch deck for angel investors, venture capital firms, family offices, accelerators, and grant committees.
6. Prepare concise investor teasers, one-page company summaries, executive briefs, and pitch scripts.
7. Continuously improve presentations based on founder feedback, investor questions, and fundraising outcomes.
8. Ensure all claims, projections, metrics, and statements are accurate, supportable, and appropriately presented.

4. Fundraising Narrative & Business Storytelling

1. Work with the founders to develop a powerful and consistent investment narrative around Purple Business.
2. Clearly communicate why small businesses need better tools for customer acquisition, marketing, advertising, and business growth.
3. Explain why advances in AI create an opportunity to fundamentally improve how small businesses operate and grow.
4. Develop convincing narratives around market size, customer problems, product differentiation, business potential, and long-term vision.
5. Articulate
   **Why this problem? Why now? Why Purple Business? Why this team?**
6. Research successful startup fundraising narratives and understand how compelling businesses communicate their investment theses.
7. Translate technical AI capabilities into understandable business benefits and investment opportunities.
8. Adapt storytelling for different audiences while keeping the company's underlying business facts consistent.
9. Help the founders develop clear answers to challenging investor questions and objections.

Key Expected Deliverables

1. **Investor Database:**
   A structured and regularly updated database of relevant angel investors, VC firms, family offices, and investment networks.
2. **Funding Opportunity Tracker:**
   A comprehensive list of grants, incubators, accelerators, funding programs, and their application requirements.
3. **Investor Pitch Deck:**
   Professional, visually compelling pitch decks customized for different investor audiences.
4. **Fundraising Narrative:**
   A clear and persuasive story explaining the problem, market opportunity, solution, business model, competitive advantage, and long-term vision.
5. **Financial Models:**
   Revenue projections, subscription economics, operating cost estimates, funding scenarios, and unit economics analysis.
6. **Funding Applications:**
   Well-researched and accurately completed applications submitted to relevant programs after founder approval.
7. **Investor Outreach Pipeline:**
   Organized investor outreach, follow-ups, meetings, and relationship tracking.
8. **Pitching & Investor Preparation:**
   Pitch scripts, FAQ documents, objection-handling notes, and investor meeting preparation.
9. **Investor Data Room:**
   Organized fundraising documents, approved company information, financial records, and supporting evidence.
10. **Weekly Fundraising Updates:**
    Progress reports highlighting upcoming deadlines, investor responses, opportunities, challenges, and recommended next steps.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is genuinely fascinated by
**how startups raise money, how investors evaluate businesses, and how companies turn ideas into sustainable, scalable organizations.**

You should enjoy researching investors, analyzing business models, studying financial numbers, creating compelling presentations, and exploring new funding opportunities.

We're particularly interested in individuals who:

* Are obsessed with understanding numbers and business economics.
* Can turn complex business information into clear, persuasive presentations.
* Enjoy identifying opportunities and independently finding ways to pursue them.
* Are extremely organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines.
* Have strong research skills and can distinguish credible information from unsupported assumptions.
* Can confidently communicate with investors and other business professionals.
* Want direct exposure to the challenges of building and financing an early-stage AI startup.

How to Apply

Please share:

1. Your resume and LinkedIn profile.
2. Any relevant experience involving startup research, financial analysis, pitch decks, investment research, or business competitions.
3. Examples of financial models, research presentations, or pitch decks you've created, if available.

**Join the Founder's Office at Purple Business and gain hands-on experience in fundraising, investor relations, business strategy, and building an AI startup from the ground up.**

**Purple Business**

title: Associate Director - Grid Integration, Renewable Energy
description:
**About Enfinity Global**

Enfinity Global is a purpose-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon-free and sustainable economy. Our role as a leading IPP is to develop, finance, build, operate, and own decarbonization assets in the long term in Europe, Asia, and the Americas through our offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan.

Our team of over 400 Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.

**Job Description:**

Enfinity Global is looking for a Senior Interconnection Leader with 10-15 years of experience who will be responsible for managing the transmission-level interconnection process for utility-scale solar, battery energy storage projects and large load interconnection across the United States.

The candidate should possess deep technical expertise in FERC regulations, interconnection studies, and grid integration, while demonstrating strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills. This position requires extensive collaboration with US-based teams, utilities, Independent System Operators (ISOs), Regional Transmission Organizations (RTOs), and engineering consultants.

The role demands an individual who is highly organized, strategic, and capable of managing complex interconnection processes from initial feasibility through Commercial Operation Date (COD). The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact with transmission providers and ISO/RTO interconnection departments, managing a portfolio of projects totaling multiple gigawatts.

This opportunity provides significant exposure to the US energy market and interconnection reform landscape including FERC Order 2023 implementation. Candidates will work closely with key stakeholders based in the US and will require flexibility to overlap 3-4 hours daily with US business hours.

**Key responsibilities:**

***Interconnection Process Management:***

·       Lead and manage the complete interconnection queue process for transmission-level renewable energy projects (solar, wind, and battery storage) from initial site selection and feasibility through Commercial Operation Date (COD), ensuring compliance with all regulatory and technical requirements.

·       Coordinate and submit interconnection applications, deposits, study agreements, and all required technical documentation to utilities, ISOs/RTOs including CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP, NYISO, and ISO-NE within prescribed deadlines.

·       Manage queue positions and track interconnection study milestones including Cluster Studies, System Impact Studies (SIS), Facilities Studies (FS), and Affected System Studies across multiple ISO/RTO markets simultaneously.

·       Review, analyze, and challenge interconnection study results including load flow analysis, short circuit studies, stability analysis, and network upgrade requirements to optimize project economics and timelines.

·       Negotiate and execute Interconnection Agreements (IAs), Generator Interconnection Agreements (GIAs), and Large Generator Interconnection Agreements (LGIAs), including cost allocation, construction schedules, and milestone payment terms.

·       Manage interconnection financial commitments including study deposits, security postings, milestone payments, and network upgrade funding in accordance with FERC-approved tariff requirements.

***Technical Coordination & Analysis:***

·       Collaborate with internal engineering teams and external consultants to develop technical specifications, electrical one-line diagrams, and three-line diagrams for interconnection applications, ensuring accuracy and compliance with utility standards.

·       Conduct comprehensive due diligence reviews and technical feasibility assessments for potential project sites, evaluating transmission capacity, congestion patterns, and available interconnection options.

·       Evaluate and forecast network upgrade costs including reliability upgrades, delivery network upgrades, stand-alone network upgrades, and cost allocation methodologies under shared funding scenarios.

·       Assess and recommend alternative Point of Interconnection (POI) options, voltage levels, and interconnection configurations to optimize project economics, construction schedules, and commercial viability.

·       Support transmission planning activities including transmission service requests (TSRs), Network Resource Interconnection Service (NRIS) applications, and participation in regional transmission planning processes.

·       Monitor, interpret, and implement changes to utilities, ISO/RTO interconnection procedures, FERC Order compliance (Order 2023, 2023-A), queue reform initiatives, and cluster study process modifications across all relevant markets.

***Stakeholder Management & Communication:***

·       Serve as primary point of contact with transmission owners, transmission providers, utility interconnection departments, and ISO/RTO interconnection staff, building and maintaining productive long-term working relationships.

·       Coordinate closely with US-based development, origination, engineering, legal, and finance teams requiring regular availability during overlapping business hours.

·       Participate in ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings, interconnection working groups, and industry forums to stay current on policy developments and advocate for company positions on interconnection reform matters.

·       Prepare and deliver regular status updates, risk assessments, and executive summaries to senior management on portfolio-level interconnection progress, upcoming milestones, and potential risks.

·       Lead resolution of interconnection disputes, study delays, and billing discrepancies through direct engagement with utility staff, escalation procedures, and formal complaint processes when necessary.

·       Manage and provide technical oversight to external consultants and engineering firms supporting interconnection studies, deliverable preparation, and utility coordination activities.

***Portfolio Management, Data Analytics & Process Improvement:***

·       Maintain comprehensive interconnection tracking systems, databases, and project management tools for a portfolio of projects totaling multiple gigawatts across various development stages.

·       Monitor queue positions, withdrawal risks, restudy impacts, and queue reform implementation effects across multiple utilities and ISO/RTO markets, proactively identifying opportunities and risks.

·       Develop and maintain interconnection cost forecasts, timeline projections, and risk registers for financial modeling, budgeting, and project valuation purposes.

·       Analyze interconnection study data from customer engagement meetings, scoping meetings, and draft study reports to support informed strategic decision-making and site optimization.

·       Track regional transmission planning processes, proposed transmission projects, and policy changes that may impact interconnection feasibility or project economics.

·       Develop and implement best practices, standard operating procedures, templates, and lessons learned documentation to improve efficiency and reduce execution risk across the interconnection portfolio.

·       Create and maintain interconnection playbooks, process workflows, and training materials for internal teams to ensure consistent execution and knowledge transfer.

**Requirements**

The candidate will require exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong technical analysis capabilities, and experience navigating multiple utilities and ISO/RTO markets. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with ambitious growth strategies.

**Qualifications & experience:**

***Education:***

·       Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related technical field (Master's degree preferred).

***Experience:***

·       10-15 years of hands-on experience managing transmission-level interconnection processes for utility-scale renewable energy projects.

·       Proven track record of successfully navigating interconnection queues with at least 5+ projects through to executed Interconnection Agreements.

·       Direct experience working with multiple U.S. Utilities & ISO/RTO markets.

·       Experience with solar, battery energy storage system (BESS), and large load interconnection projects.

·       Background working with IPPs, renewable energy developers, or utilities in project development roles.

***Technical Expertise:***

·       Deep understanding of FERC regulations, NERC standards, and transmission planning principles.

·       Comprehensive knowledge of Large Generator Interconnection Procedures (LGIP), Large Load Interconnection and interconnection study methodologies.

·       Proficiency in interpreting power system studies including load flow, short circuit, stability, and EMT studies.

·       Working knowledge of power systems modeling software and tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, PSCAD, PowerWorld, or TARA for reviewing and validating study results.

·       Familiarity with electrical single-line diagrams, substation design concepts, protection and control systems, and transmission system configurations.

·       Knowledge of reactive power requirements, voltage regulation, and grid code compliance for renewable generation.

***Skills & Competencies:***

·       Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

·       Strong project management capabilities with ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.

·       Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills with utilities, transmission owners, and system operators.

·       Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, project management, and CRM.

·       Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

·       Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment.

·       Creative thinker, trying to find new ways of optimizing interconnection strategies.

·       Hands-on mentality and focus on getting things done.

·       Taking ownership and wanting to get things right.

***Preferred Qualifications:***

·       Experience with co-located or hybrid projects (solar + storage, wind + storage).

·       Familiarity with offshore wind interconnection processes.

·       Knowledge of transmission congestion, LMP pricing, and merchant transmission development.

·       Experience participating in ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings and working groups.

·       Background in power systems modeling software (PSS/E, PSCAD, PowerWorld, etc.).

·       Previous experience working for a US-based company from an India office.

In Enfinity Global you will find a very dynamic and multinational environment in one of the most exciting and impactful industries. Here we will foster your professional and personal growth, and you will have the opportunity to actively contribute and make a real impact on climate change.

**Let's build our future together.**

Visit www.enfinity.global to discover more about our culture

title: Tech Process Senior Specialist - Customer Support (Orion) - PMAX
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Product Consultant, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support [across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
  
  
In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Technical Product Consultant will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****Position Responsibilities**
**:****

* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root-cause analysis to implement long-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end-to-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.
* Engineering Liaison & Bug Management: Own the end-to-end bug reporting lifecycle. Translate complex, ambiguous technical failures into high-quality bug reports for Engineering, ensuring all technical requirements, reproduction steps, and impact assessments are clearly communicated to drive faster resolution.
* Knowledge Architecture: Partner with Product Enablement Team and Center of Excellence team to co-create, update, and audit troubleshooting content and documentation for current products and new Beta releases.
* Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, and CoEs to provide strategic feedback based on support trends. Lead deep-dive root cause analysis to advocate for product and process improvements.
* Ecosystem Empowerment: Develop and deliver formal training, "Train-the-Trainer" (TTT) sessions, and certification programs to build a pipeline of product experts across GOC L1 and partner teams.
* AI & Innovation: Manage Agent Assist pilots for relevant new product launches and validate AI-generated support outputs. Model domain knowledge to improve automated support tools and test outputs for upcoming product features.
* Data-Driven Insights: Analyze complex datasets to identify systemic issues and performance trends. Translate these insights into actionable business recommendations to enhance the customer journey.
* Inclusive Leadership: Drive a culture of mentorship. Guide frontline SMEs on product nuances and foster a collaborative, globally dispersed team environment.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in project/program management, technical consulting, or a client-facing role.
* 4+ years of experience specifically within the Ads Product ecosystem
* Experience in end-to-end Campaign Operations and Performance Diagnostics, including media planning, traffic analysis, and real-time optimization. Must have a proven track record of performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex delivery issues and translating technical troubleshooting into customer-centric solutions.
* Strong written and oral communication and experiencing interfacing with Engineering and Product teams
* Experience in content development or knowledge management; with a focus on translating internal product specifications into actionable support content and instructional materials for iterative product releases.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation (e.g., SQL, PLX).
* Ability to pivot expertise across different Google Ads products [Search, Video, Display, Mobile, Commerce et] Platform analytics and tools.
* Proven track record of navigating interdependent processes and making decisions that prioritize the customer in ambiguous situations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and competing priorities under tight deadlines.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

title: Associate - Business Process & AI Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
As an Associate you will support the delivery CCOR Operations Transformation Capability AI-enabled initiatives within CCOR by conducting end-to-end process analysis, process mapping, process reimagination, and operating model design. You will partner with operations stakeholders, process owners, product delivery, technology, data science, and controls teams to identify inefficiencies and define future-state workflows. You will translate business needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria to enable solution design and implementation. You will support testing, validation, and implementation readiness to confirm delivered solutions align to the agreed future-state process. You will help establish baselines and success measures to track benefits, controls, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Develop detailed current-state and future-state process maps using Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0, capturing workflows, decision points, hand-offs, exceptions, dependencies, and human interventions.
* Analyze existing processes to identify inefficiencies, manual effort, duplication, bottlenecks, and control gaps; redesign workflows to simplify operations and improve quality, efficiency, and consistency.
* Identify and assess opportunities for large language model-based solutions, guided pathways, agentic workflows, low-code automation, and other intelligent solutions based on business needs, process suitability, and expected outcomes.
* Translate process analysis into proposed future-state operating models, defining roles, responsibilities, human decision points, exception handling, quality checks, and interactions between operations and technology-enabled solutions.

description: Position DescriptionLocation – Flexible / RemoteJob OverviewMain Purpose Of The Role Ensure new, changed and continuously evolving services are designed, introduced and assured so they are operable, secure, resilient, supportable and measurable from day one. title: Senior Lead Engineer – Datalink Systems (Hybrid)
description:
**Date Posted:**
2026-10-26
  
  
**Country:**
India

IN-TS-HYDERABAD-B3F7 ~ DLF Cybercity Gachibowli ~ DLF CYBERCITY GACHIBOWLI-B3F7, 7th Fl in Block 3

**Shape the Future of Aerospace Technology**
At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185,000 professionals are united by a common purpose: solving the world's most complex challenges through innovation, advanced technology, and engineering excellence.
  
  
Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, is at the forefront of developing intelligent, technologically advanced aerospace solutions that redefine the future of flight. Our innovations help connect aircraft, enable reliable communications, and support safer, more efficient aviation worldwide.
  
  
Join our team and bring your systems-engineering expertise to the development of next-generation avionics solutions that connect and protect our world.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Systems Engineer – Avionics Datalink Systems**
to drive systems-engineering activities across complex, safety-critical avionics platforms. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the development, integration, verification, and certification of avionics datalink subsystems, working with technologies such as RIU, CMU, ATSU, ACR, DLCA, and Link2K.
  
  
You will translate customer and industry requirements into robust engineering solutions, support system architecture and interface definition, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver reliable, compliant, and high-quality avionics products.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong systems-engineering fundamentals with practical knowledge of avionics communication protocols, requirements management, and aerospace development standards, along with a proactive approach to solving challenging system-level problems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Avionics Systems Engineering**

* Lead and contribute to systems-engineering activities across avionics datalink portfolios, including RIU, CMU, ATSU, ACR, DLCA, and Link2K.
* Support system architecture development, requirements decomposition, interface definition, subsystem integration, verification, and validation.
* Analyze customer, system, and industry requirements and translate them into clear, measurable, verifiable, and traceable engineering requirements.
* Collaborate with hardware, software, systems, verification, and certification teams to deliver integrated avionics solutions.
* Identify technical challenges, assess system-level impacts, and drive engineering issues toward resolution throughout the product lifecycle.

**Avionics Communication and Interface Engineering**

* Apply knowledge of avionics communication protocols, including ARINC 429 (A429), ARINC 618, ARINC 739, ARINC 758, and ARINC 724B.
* Analyze avionics interfaces, communication flows, and interactions between system components and subsystems.
* Support interface definition, integration, troubleshooting, and verification activities to ensure seamless system interoperability.
* Contribute to the analysis and resolution of interface-related issues encountered during integration and testing.

**Requirements Management And Engineering Excellence**

* Develop, review, maintain, and manage system requirements using tools such as Jama and IBM DOORS.
* Establish and maintain end-to-end requirements traceability across customer, system, subsystem, and verification levels.
* Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, testable, and aligned with customer expectations and system objectives.
* Support requirements verification, validation, baseline management, and change-impact assessments.
* Participate in technical reviews and ensure engineering artifacts meet applicable quality and process requirements.

**Integration, Verification, and Certification**

* Support the integration, testing, verification, and validation of avionics datalink subsystems.
* Review test procedures, analyze test results, investigate anomalies, and support root-cause analysis of system-level issues.
* Work closely with verification and test teams to demonstrate compliance with system requirements and performance expectations.
* Support certification activities by contributing technical analyses, verification evidence, and engineering documentation.
* Apply structured engineering methods to ensure product reliability, quality, and compliance throughout the development lifecycle.

**Systems Safety, Standards, and Compliance**

* Apply aerospace systems-engineering principles and relevant development processes, with particular emphasis on ARP4754.
* Support the development of safety-critical avionics products within regulated engineering and certification environments.
* Participate in engineering reviews, technical assessments, process evaluations, and internal and external quality audits.
* Collaborate with quality and certification stakeholders to address compliance gaps and maintain engineering integrity.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen engineering processes, improve product quality, and enhance development efficiency.

**Collaboration, Ownership, and Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with cross-functional and geographically distributed engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges.
* Communicate technical findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrate accountability for assigned deliverables and proactively manage technical issues and priorities.
* Contribute to engineering best practices, process improvements, and technical knowledge sharing.
* Embrace continuous learning and evolving engineering practices, including Agile methodologies where applicable.

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Technology, or Mathematics (STEM), or equivalent relevant experience.
* 6-9 years of systems-engineering experience in aerospace, avionics, defense, or another safety-critical industry.
* 6+ Years of Proven experience in the development, integration, testing, or verification of avionics subsystems, preferably RIU, CMU, CMF, or related avionics communication platforms.
* 5+ Years of Strong knowledge of avionics communication protocols, particularly ARINC 429, ARINC 618, ARINC 739, and ARINC 758.
* Solid understanding of system requirements engineering, requirements decomposition, traceability, verification, and change management.
* Hands-on experience with requirements-management tools such as Jama and/or IBM DOORS.
* 4+ Years of Strong knowledge of ARP4754 and its application in aerospace systems engineering.
* 4+ Years of Experience in supporting system integration, interface analysis, verification, testing, or resolution of system-level technical issues.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary engineering teams and deliver results in a structured, quality-focused environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with avionics datalink systems such as RIU, CMU, ATSU, ACR, DLCA, or Link2K.
* Familiarity with ARINC 724B and additional avionics communication standards.
* Exposure to I/O-related activities, interface testing, and hardware-software integration.
* Familiarity with aerospace certification practices, safety-critical development processes, and engineering assurance activities.
* Experience working with Agile development methodologies and modern systems-engineering practices.
* Demonstrated initiative, technical curiosity, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous professional development.

**The Engineer We're Looking For**
You are a technically strong, analytical, and collaborative engineer who enjoys understanding complex systems and turning challenging requirements into practical engineering solutions.
  
  
You take ownership of your work, communicate effectively across disciplines, and approach technical challenges with structured problem-solving and sound engineering judgment. You are comfortable working in a dynamic, regulated environment and motivated to expand your expertise while contributing to meaningful aerospace innovations.
  
  
Most importantly, you are passionate about engineering reliable avionics systems that meet demanding standards for safety, performance, and quality.
  
  
**Why Collins Aerospace?**
At Collins Aerospace, you will work alongside experienced engineering professionals, contribute to advanced avionics technologies, and help deliver solutions that support the future of global aviation. We foster an environment that values technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Bring your expertise. Take ownership of complex engineering challenges. Help shape the next generation of avionics systems with Collins Aerospace.**
*RTX adheres to the principles of equal employment. All qualified applications will be given careful consideration without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: eDMS Administrator
description:
Imaging Endpoints (IE) is an Imaging Technology and Imaging Clinical Research Organization (iCRO). We are passionately focused on our vision to
*Connect Imaging to the CureTM*
. Everything we do is aligned with this singular purpose. We work every day excited to advance imaging science, technology, and services to bring curative technologies to humankind. We have supported many of the most impactful new drug approvals in oncology, and we are seeking the most talented individuals globally that are passionate in their desire to assist us in our mission to customize each clinical trial’s imaging to optimize the opportunity to demonstrate efficacy.

Imaging Endpoints is based in Scottsdale, Arizona, with offices in Cambridge, Massachusetts; London, UK; Leiden, Netherlands; Basel, Switzerland; Hyderabad, India and Shanghai, China. We are an affiliate of HonorHealth, one of the largest healthcare systems nationally, and Scottsdale Medical Imaging Limited (SMIL/RadPartners), the largest private radiology group in the United States. We are recognized as the world’s largest and most preeminent iCRO in oncology.

The eDMS Administrator is primarily responsible for assisting Compliance and Regulatory Affairs management in executing day-to-day tasks associated with managing, maintaining, and continually improving Imaging Endpoints’ document management system to meet quality and regulatory requirements.

The eDMS Administrator is a compliance and solutions oriented individual; facilitating timely and compliant document management decision making and providing regulatory support. This individual is instrumental in achieving business and stakeholder needs with respect to document management principles and practices.

**eDMS Administrator**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Leads the efforts in managing and oversight of the companywide electronic document management system (eDMS) and provides administrator role support.
* Responsible for maintaining and updating eDMS system and workflow changes.
* Responsible for eDMS configuration and workflow development for QMS documents.
* Responsible to implement workflows for electronic document management, including authoring, collaboration, publication, storage, and retrieval of documents.
* Develop training program and material related to eDMS.
* Manage electronic QMS records within the eDMS including, job descriptions, personal CVs,
* SOPs, organizational charts etc.
* Manage electronic training documents and develop training reporting processes within the eDMS.
* Responsible for creating and fostering mutually beneficial intradepartmental, cross-functional and organizational relationships to drive compliance to eDMS QMS requirements.
* Interface with Compliance and Regulatory Affairs management to implement quality system strategies and plans to facilitate continuous improvement of the QMS regarding document management initiatives.
* Develops SOPs and controls related to GxP document management.
* Assist Compliance and Regulatory Affairs management during Internal Audits, Sponsor Audits or
* Regulatory Inspections as related to QMS related eDMS documentation preparedness.
* Assist in establishing and reporting quality metrics related to document management.
* Act as the primary contact for the IE eDMS change management program. Manage and report on the change management process and activities related QMS document management and control.
* Ensure proper control, retention, and archival of QMS documents per regulatory requirements.
* Assist in establishing, implementing and maintaining QA procedures and controls to develop an effective, efficient and compliant IE QMS change management program.
* Perform other duties as assigned by Compliance and Regulatory Affairs management.
* Act in a supporting role to other QMS Specialist positions.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical sciences or other related scientific discipline.
* Minimum five (5) years of experience in a regulated industry with at least three (3) years of experience in eDMS management and administration.
* Subject matter expertise in a commercial eDMS system, with preferred experience as a MasterControl Administrator or equivalent.
* Imaging Core Lab and/or CRO experience preferred.
* Knowledge and understanding of Good Clinical Practices (ICH E6 GCP), Good Documentation
* Practices (GDP) and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Proficiency in MS Office and internet applications

**SKILLS**

* Superior attention to detail, particularly in written documentation
* Service oriented approach, flexible, and proactive
* Self-driven, ability to get the job done with little supervision, can-do positive attitude
* Ability to excel in a team environment
* Ability to work in strict compliance with all procedures, rules, and regulations
* Ability to manage projects and deliverables with a high level of accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive data, records, files, conversations, etc.
* Must be self-motivated and able to grasp new concepts quickly
* Excellent hands-on computer skills with thorough knowledge of Microsoft Office to include Word, Excel and Power Point.

**IMAGING ENDPOINTS’ TEAM CHARACTERISTICS**

* Passion to
  *Connect Imaging to the CureTM*
  and pursue a meaningful career by improving the lives of cancer patients through imaging
* Strong desire to be part of a dynamic, global team working closely together and growing year after year in a rewarding environment to help humanity through imaging
* Commitment and caring for our fellow team members, their families, and the communities IE serves - see more information about Caring Endpoints at https://caringendpoints.org/
* Integrity and high ethical standards; we always do the right thing
* High intellect and ingenuity; we enjoy solving problems, finding a better way, and the challenge of making a difference by improving lives
* Structured, organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; we approach each day with a detailed plan and excitement to accomplish the day’s objectives while striving to improve ourselves and IE
* Accountable; we do what we say and communicative effectively to meet deadlines; we enjoy advancing clinical trials, helping patients, and celebrating success
* High standard for excellence; we proof our own work, hold high standards for ourselves and our team, and always prioritize quality above all else

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, ability to adjust focus.

Travel: Estimated up to 10% travel (domestic and international)
