title: Process Control System Engineer
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
**Description**
As a Process Control System Engineer at Micron, you will play a crucial role in developing smart manufacturing solutions that set the standard for Industry 4.0. This outstanding opportunity will allow you to gain knowledge in innovative areas such as Machine Learning, Advanced Control Solutions, and Deep Learning. You will be responsible for crafting comprehensive solutions that encompass requirements gathering, data analysis, and system development and integration, leading to network-wide implementation. Your work will have a direct impact on our company's success by improving process capabilities and ensuring quality output through advanced process control measures. Collaboration with various process areas will be key to understanding their tools and challenges, allowing you to develop effective process control models and strategies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and improve smart control solutions to achieve efficient manufacturing performance.
* Provide technical oversight, mentorship, and support for process control implementation.
* Conduct intensive data analysis and modeling to identify process variations and translate findings into control solutions.
* Support PDE KEG team in Classification, Characterization, and Categorization, defining data collection requirements and performing integration and setup in the E3 Environment.
* Define analysis and setup requirements, establish limits, and engage in periodic reviews with the PCS team on best-known methods.
* Develop Run-to-Run control requirements and build controllers for real-time closed-loop process tuning in assembly processes.
* Deliver training on control systems and related topics to ensure team proficiency.

Requirement
  
  

* Doctorate, Master's, or Bachelor's level education in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Physics, or relevant professional experience.
* Passion for programming and data analysis.
* Familiarity with Machine Learning.
* Preferred experience with Python, R, SQL, C#, Hadoop ecosystem, and/or web-based application development.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven project management abilities.
* Ambitious with the ability to multitask and manage dynamic priorities.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a great teammate.
* Ability to work in a multi-functional team environment.
* Current supervisor recommendation as a viable candidate.
* Willingness and capability for international travel, as needed.
* Leveraging AI to automate the work & ability to work/develop AI predictive systems
* Experience in semiconductor manufacturing and packaging is advantageous.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**
We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life
*for all*
. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
  
  
To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com

title: Tech Process Senior Specialist - Customer Support (Orion) - Display
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Product Consultant, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support [across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
  
  
In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Technical Product Consultant will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****Position Responsibilities**
**:****

* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root-cause analysis to implement long-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end-to-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.
* Engineering Liaison & Bug Management: Own the end-to-end bug reporting lifecycle. Translate complex, ambiguous technical failures into high-quality bug reports for Engineering, ensuring all technical requirements, reproduction steps, and impact assessments are clearly communicated to drive faster resolution.
* Knowledge Architecture: Partner with Product Enablement Team and Center of Excellence team to co-create, update, and audit troubleshooting content and documentation for current products and new Beta releases.
* Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, and CoEs to provide strategic feedback based on support trends. Lead deep-dive root cause analysis to advocate for product and process improvements.
* Ecosystem Empowerment: Develop and deliver formal training, "Train-the-Trainer" (TTT) sessions, and certification programs to build a pipeline of product experts across GOC L1 and partner teams.
* AI & Innovation: Manage Agent Assist pilots for relevant new product launches and validate AI-generated support outputs. Model domain knowledge to improve automated support tools and test outputs for upcoming product features.
* Data-Driven Insights: Analyze complex datasets to identify systemic issues and performance trends. Translate these insights into actionable business recommendations to enhance the customer journey.
* Inclusive Leadership: Drive a culture of mentorship. Guide frontline SMEs on product nuances and foster a collaborative, globally dispersed team environment.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in project/program management, technical consulting, or a client-facing role.
* 4+ years of experience specifically within the Ads Product ecosystem
* Experience in end-to-end Campaign Operations and Performance Diagnostics, including media planning, traffic analysis, and real-time optimization. Must have a proven track record of performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex delivery issues and translating technical troubleshooting into customer-centric solutions.
* Strong written and oral communication and experiencing interfacing with Engineering and Product teams
* Experience in content development or knowledge management; with a focus on translating internal product specifications into actionable support content and instructional materials for iterative product releases.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation (e.g., SQL, PLX).
* Ability to pivot expertise across different Google Ads products [Search, Video, Display, Mobile, Commerce et] Platform analytics and tools.
* Proven track record of navigating interdependent processes and making decisions that prioritize the customer in ambiguous situations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and competing priorities under tight deadlines.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Technical Liaisoning & QA
description:
**Role: TSEC & Liaison**

**Position Summary**

Assistant Manager or Deputy Manager in Hyderabad to handle technical liaison with government telecom customers for our Lithium-Ion battery and SMPS power plant products.

**Role Purpose**

The role is the company's technical face to government telecom customers in the region. The incumbent ensures our Lithium-Ion battery packs and SMPS power plants meet customer technical specifications, and approvals.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Act as the single technical point of contact for government and PSU telecom customers (e.g., BSNL).
2. Study customer technical specifications, and GR/TEC requirements and align the team accordingly.
3. Coordinate type testing, product approvals, pre-dispatch inspections and customer witness tests.
4. Resolve field issues and complaints with root-cause analysis and corrective action, working with Quality, Production and R&D teams.
5. Follow up on approvals, inspection certificates, documentation and related clearances with customer offices.
6. Build and maintain working relationships with customer and officials at circle and corporate levels.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Experience: 6–7 years overall, including at least 3–4 years in the electrical industry.
* Domain exposure: Hands-on exposure to Lithium-Ion batteries and SMPS power plants used in telecom applications (e.g., 48V DC power systems, rectifiers, battery banks).
* Government liaison: Proven experience liaising with government or PSU customers to meet their technical requirements, including specifications, approvals, inspections and documentation.
* Technical understanding: Working knowledge of power electronics basics, battery technology and site power requirements.
* Travel: Willing to travel to customer offices and sites as required.

**Added Advantage**

title: Preconstruction Coordinator - Senior Analyst
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Houston and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will work as an embedded member of DESRI’s Preconstruction team, executing delegated tasks assigned, reviewed, and owned by U.S.-based Precon Leads. You will build a deep understanding of how DESRI takes projects from site studies and technical due diligence through EPC procurement and contract execution, and progressively take on a more active role in supporting consultant engagement, RFP management, scheduling, bid evaluation, and contract administration.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Operate as an embedded member of the Preconstruction team, participating in project calls, email traffic, and internal discussions across assigned Precon Leads’ project portfolios.
* Support consultant proposal solicitation and comparison — reaching out to EORs, geotechnical firms, and other consultants against provided SOWs, tracking responses, and building structured cost, scope, and schedule comparison matrices for Precon Lead review.
* Support RFP preparation and data room setup — compiling and formatting RFP packages, drafting standard RFP sections from established templates, and building out and maintaining data rooms against the RFP checklist.
* Coordinate EPC outreach logistics for RFP preview and release, tracking confirmations, managing distribution lists, and maintaining a log of outreach communications for Precon Lead visibility.
* Maintain and update the living SOW document as project inputs evolve, flagging inconsistencies between iterations and supporting progression from Preliminary SOW through RFP-level SOW to Final Contract SOW.
* Support development and ongoing maintenance of the preconstruction schedule, tracking milestones across site studies, EPC engagement, RFP issuance, and contract execution, and flagging schedule risks and delays for Precon Lead attention.
* Build out bid leveling matrices and comparison frameworks, compile initial proposal-vs-scope alignment reviews, and organize bidder clarification logs and Q&A trackers.
* Maintain version-controlled Basis of Design (BOD) logs across project iterations, flagging equipment selection changes and downstream impacts for Precon Lead awareness.
* Support development of project-specific EPC risk registers, contributing to populating and maintaining the register as familiarity with individual projects and site conditions builds.
* Maintain a master exhibit log for each active contract, tracking current exhibit versions, ownership, and outstanding open items, and surfacing anything stale or blocking progress for Precon Lead attention.
* Receive, organize, and log redlined exhibits, preparing clean comparison documents for Precon Lead review, and support the Contracts Manager in maintaining the baseline exhibit template library.
* Triage contract-related email and correspondence, summarizing outstanding items and action owners for Precon Lead review, and flagging urgent items requiring immediate attention.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or Construction Management or related field.
* Around 2–5 years of experience with large infrastructure or energy projects — in preconstruction, project development, project controls, owner’s engineer / PMC, contracts administration, or infrastructure advisory. Renewable energy experience is preferred but not required.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple RFP, estimating, and contract workstreams and data rooms simultaneously.
* Comfort with contract administration, version control, and detailed document tracking, including redlines, exhibit logs, and checklists.
* Working knowledge of project scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 or MS Project and strong Excel skills; exposure to Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, or Smartsheet is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work directly with senior U.S.-based Precon Leads, Contracts Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Comfort operating across multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, in an environment where scope is not always fully defined.
* A proactive and detail-oriented approach, with the judgment to flag gaps, risks, and blockers — such as stale exhibits, schedule slippage, or scope outliers — before they impact deadlines.

title: Senior Technical Engineer – LabVantage Master Data
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
**About The Technology Organization**
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
**About The Business Function**
From molecule to market, Global Manufacturing plays an important role in every step along a product’s lifecycle. Most of our customers never see the scientific and technical resources behind our medicines. But customers experience, every day, the performance of our high-quality products and global supply network.
  
  
Global Manufacturing comprises a core group of functions that drives the production and supply of high-quality products: Engineering; Manufacturing Information & Control Systems (Technology@Lilly); Quality & Labs, Technology Services/Manufacturing Science; Global Health, Safety and Environment; and Supply Chain.
  
  
**Role: Senior Technical Engineer – LabVantage Master Data**
The Senior Technical Engineer will be leading designing, building, and automating analytical test methods and associated data and specifications within LabVantage LIMS, and for developing or coordinating the development of instrument drivers and integrations that enable direct data capture into LIMS from laboratory instruments.
  
  
This role combines domain expertise in laboratory processes and analytical methods with technical leadership in LIMS MD configuration & Custom development. The incumbent will play a key role in advancing the organization’s digital laboratory ecosystem, driving data integrity, automation, and compliance in GxP systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What**
**you’ll**
**be doing:**
**LabVantage MD Development & Build**

* Develop the configuration, creation, and lifecycle management of analytical test methods in LabVantage LIMS (i.e. All interconnected MDs to support entire workflow for test method to work as per expectations).
* Implement test templates, specifications, and parameter lists ensuring standardization and scalability across products and sites.
* Define and maintain Test method metadata structures for automation (units, limits, calculations, result entry templates).
* Custom Script development for data transfer or verifications
* Implement Test method versioning, review, and approval workflows in accordance with organisational data governance and validation policies.
* Partner with functional SMEs to ensure test methods adhering with GxP, ALCOA+, and analytical method validation principles.
* Build test scenarios/ documents and Test method templates

**Technical Maintenance and Master Data Support**

* Triage, analyze and resolve issues through root cause analysis, harnessing both business and technical knowledge to minimize downtime.
* Driver L3 Engineering with global data team, site team and ensuring timely completion
* Develop and maintain scripts, business rules, and LabVantage SDK components to automate data processing and workflow activities.
* Enable service improvement through fixes of incidences
* Support and analyze instrument integrations (e.g.,Lab Application - Empower, Chromeleon, SmartLab, Darwin, Complex instruments) and maintain data exchange with ERP, ELN, QMS, EM and analytics systems.

**Automation & Digital Integration**

* Develop automation frameworks to reduce manual effort in test method setup and instrument data handling.
* Support initiatives for automated test method build from structured templates or upstream systems (ERP/PLM).
* Collaborate with analytics teams to make instrument and method data analytics-ready for dashboards and trending.

**Governance, Validation & Documentation**

* Support for versioned MD, and auditable as part of GxP compliance and following regulatory and Lilly IT quality standards (CSV-Computer System Validation).
* Create design documents, configuration specifications and technical SOPs for test method.
* Support QA in CSV, change control, and periodic review activities.
* Active participation in audits and ensure all automation components meet 21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain design specifications, configuration documentation, and validation test scripts for IQ/OQ/PQ activities along with installation procedures
* Support change control, release management, ensuring compliance and stability in a multi-environment setup.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Strong technical SME for LabVantage test method management
* Collaboration with site-level LabVantage data stewards to lead test methods management
* Partner with global digital, quality, and IT SMEs to define and implement standards for method and instrument onboarding.
* Enable process improvement through automation, template standardization, and adoption of new technologies

**How You Will Succeed**

* Reduced manual effort and faster development of new test methods.
* Improved data flow between LabVantage and analytical instruments in secured environment
* Compliance with global lab data governance and validation standards.
* Enablement of analytics-ready, high-quality laboratory data.

**What You Should Bring**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking.
* Technical proficiency in LIMS MD development, management and delievrables
* Understanding of analytical lab workflows and instruments.
* Excellent documentation and verbal communication

title: Industrial Trainee - Controlling
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Pursuing Chartered Accountancy course, having cleared CA-Inter/IPCC in first or second attempt, and having completed a minimum of one year of articleship
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to take initiative with limited direction and guidance
* Duration of the role is nine to twelve months

**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will prepare, review, and file U.S. GAAP-based financial statements for the company's renewable energy projects, investment funds, and corporate entities (collectively, the “Entities”), while maintaining books and records in accordance with U.S. GAAP and ensuring adherence to close timelines and control procedures.
  
  
You will prepare Management reports including EBITDA reports, quarterly project forecasted trial balances, and conduct budget vs. actual and forecast vs. actual analysis.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to liaise with auditors and ensure timely closure of external audits, while interacting with the U.S. and Hyderabad-based asset managers, treasury and tax team associates, and external consultants. Throughout the role, you will also get the opportunity to work on initiatives related to establishing, standardizing, optimizing, and documenting accounting processes, workflows, and controls.

title: Senior Manager - Talent Development (Human Capital)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a tech-oriented, accomplished, and insightful candidate to support our Technology teams in the firm’s office in Hyderabad, India. This role offers a challenging work environment and excellent opportunities to learn and grow within the technology and human capital function. The candidate will collaborate with key stakeholders to plan and implement talent development strategy for the technology practice. Additionally, the candidate will be given the opportunities to build, create, and develop various facets of the training processes, collaborate with high-caliber colleagues in a collegial environment, and lead projects independently.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for providing guidance, advisory support, and implementation to technology business groups for learning and development initiatives and practices. The role entails gathering inputs from various stakeholders in the technology practice to determine and translate learning needs into impactful learning solutions. You will partner with various technology business groups to develop talent development strategy and capability-building plans. In addition, the role requires the development and generation of strategies to address learning needs for the technology practice, including the introduction of structured programs to onboard new hires and upskill experienced employees. You will also collaborate with technical experts within the organization to ensure learning content is up-to-date, relevant, and accurate. The aim is to streamline learning processes, platforms, and practices to enhance learner experience and productivity. The role involves deploying programs and initiatives to address domain, technical and behavioral learning needs. Additionally, you will execute end-to-end program management and coordinate vendor management, data analysis, and reporting efforts.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* An MBA in human resources with over 8 - 10 years of work experience in talent development
* Proficiency in designing instructor-led and online learning programs, including facilitator, participant guides, and learning job aids
* A strategic mindset and approach towards creating learning experiences that improve learner engagement and retention levels
* A passion for the talent development and technology domain as well as robust stakeholder management skills
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, and an ability to learn quickly and execute with discipline and keen attention to detail
* Advanced skills in creating and delivering technical training, as well as excellent presentation skills
* The capability to be collaborative and team-oriented

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Prior work experience in the Information Technology industry

description:

: Group Lead – Medical Information
  
  

* Hiring Manager: Head – Scientific Communications, Medical Information & Graphics

* % of travel expected: As per business need

Sanofi Business Operations (BO) is an internal Sanofi resource organization setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. Provides functional and operational leadership to the Medical Information Writing Team, acting as the domain expert for the relevant activities within the Medical Information team, engaging stakeholders, developing the team members, and acting as a strategic thought partner aligned with the vision of the Medical Writing team. Independently research and authors response documents, reviews compendia, and prepares US FDA Annual reports with minimal guidance or supervision by the global and local Medical Information team. Proficient understanding of Medical Information achieved through a combination of product knowledge, along with editing, writing, and document management.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Acts as a strategic thought partner to the Global Medical Information function aligned with the vision of Medical Writing.
* Proficient in Conducting literature searches and reviews; and extracting/ summarizing complex data from the scientific literature.
* Independently works to generate evidence-based, accurate, current, and fair-balanced summaries of data for the creation/maintenance of scientific response documents for products in multiple therapeutic areas, develops US FDA Annual Reports, and reviews compendia
* Ability to produce medical documents according to all Sanofi relevant global guidelines, country guidelines and policies.
* Acts as a Subject Matter Expert maintaining expertise in the processes, templates, and guidelines, and key deliverables aligned with the key trends and developments in the industry.
* Provides operational and functional leadership in producing high-quality deliverables from the medical writing team.
* Peer reviews, coaches, mentors, and develops expertise within the team motivating people to excellence (on key deliverables, processes, templates, and guidelines). 8) Guides and have oversight of the end-to-end process as captured in the activity catalogue.
* Works in alignment with line function visions, demonstrating great collaboration with the team.
* Agile and knowledgeable to be able to work across different therapeutic areas and new deliverable types, willing to stretch and be the front-runner.
* Demonstrates resolve and urgency to accomplish tasks without direct authority or control. Participate in cross-functional project teams as needed. Ensure that assigned projects are completed on schedule.
* Collaborates effectively with Global Medical Information teams to execute content plans
* Demonstrates a deep understanding and/or experience of working in a regulated GXP environment

To create synergies and provide functional and operational direction across global business units, segments and key markets operations across various therapeutic areas and processes so that cost savings up to 10 mil euros are achieved with deliveries optimized through multi-layered teams
  
  

* People: 1) Maintain effective relationships with the end stakeholders (Medical scientific community) across multiple Global business units and products – with an end objective to develop medical information content as per requirement. 2) Interact effectively with stakeholders in medical and pharmacovigilance departments. 3) Constantly assist other medical information writers in developing knowledge and sharing expertise.
* Performance: 1) Act as a strategic thought partner, operational and functional leader, providing coaching, mentoring, and expertise support. 2) Provide functional expert support and oversight of deliverables (local and custom scientific response documents, US FDA Annual Reports, and Compendia Reviews) as per agreed timelines and quality. 3) Supports delivery of projects in terms of resourcing, quality, timeliness, efficiency, and high technical standards. 4) Implement relevant elements of the medical information writing plan and associated activities for the year identified for the countries and regions.
* Process: (1) Support delivery of projects in terms of resourcing, quality, timeliness, efficiency, and high technical standards for deliveries made by the group, including scientific documents and clinical/medical reports; (2) Contribute to overall quality enhancement by ensuring high scientific standards for the output produced by the group; (3) Secure adherence to compliance procedures and internal/operational risk controls in accordance with any and all applicable regulatory standards; (4) Implement relevant elements of content plans and associated activities for the year identified for the assigned countries. 5) Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per the defined process. 6) Design an overall plan of action basis end-customers feedback & improve course content and delivery, continuous improvement and efficiency.
* Stakeholder: Work closely with medical teams globally across GBUs as well as in countries/regions/areas to identify medical information needs and assist in developing assigned deliverables. 2) Liaise with the Medical department to prepare relevant & customized deliverables. 3) Collaborate with the Global Medical Information team and country medical information teams as relevant. 4) Support regulatory interactions with various health authorities for inspections.

**About You**

* Experience: ≥10 years of experience in content creation in medical information or scientific writing for the pharmaceuticals/healthcare industry, or equivalent experience in the clinical setting, pharmacovigilance; At least 10 years of direct medical information writing experience in the pharmaceutical company; Minimum 3 years of experience in managing global, cross-functional teams and working in, a Matrix environment; strong ability in managing a multi-layered team of ≥10 members; and ability to influence and negotiate difficult situations.
* Soft skills: Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), Team management, and Stakeholder management; communication skills; and ability to work independently and within a team environment, demonstrated ability to motivate, coach, or mentor people, work as an SME, develop and manage high performing teams
* Technical skills: As applicable (Including but not limited to Expert knowledge of medical information documents including Response documents, Compendia review and FDA Annual Reports, Medical operational excellence, time, and risk management skills, Excellent technical (medical) editing and writing skills, Knowledge about literature evaluation and multilevel response development). Understanding of the local country legal requirements with regards to Medical Information document provision for customers including health care professionals, patients, carers and other relevant decision makers (such as ABPI Code of Practice for UK) is desirable.
* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline (Ph.D., Master, or bachelor’s in science, D Pharms) or medical degree (MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, MD)
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of the English language (spoken and written)

title: IT Technical Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious IT Technical Intern to join our Information Technology team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in IT support, systems administration, troubleshooting, networking, cybersecurity, hardware and software management, documentation, and technology operations while collaborating with IT professionals and business users.
  
  
Our intent is to develop an IT professional who can understand the organization’s technology environment end to end, translate user and business requirements into practical technical solutions, resolve issues efficiently, support reliable IT operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and security practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand the organization’s IT infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, devices, users, technical requirements, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Assist in providing first-level technical support to employees and users through ticketing systems, email, chat, phone, or in-person support.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, network, connectivity, access, printing, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support computers, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, operating systems, and business applications.
* Assist with user account provisioning, access management, password resets, permissions, onboarding, offboarding, and identity-related tasks.
* Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and other productivity platforms, as applicable.
* Monitor IT systems, services, devices, and alerts and escalate incidents or risks according to established procedures.
* Assist with network troubleshooting involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, routers, and related infrastructure.

title: IT&D Executive Assistant
description:

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital

**About The Role**
Explore the forefront of purposeful technology and innovation as an IT & D Business Analyst at Reckitt. Within our collaborative IT & Digital team, every day is a chance to create meaningful impact. Here, you'll be ensuring excellence across a global network that's dedicated to a cleaner, healthier world. If you possess a blend of strategic thinking and technical expertise, and you're ready to transform business needs into cutting-edge IT & D solutions, we would love to hear from you. * Engage in data analysis, user research, and other studies to bolster product development and enhancements.

* Navigate complex data landscapes, interpreting and defining specifications for technological processes.

* Skilled in change management practises with a focus on stakeholder relationship management and user adoption.
* Strong communication skills, capable of advising and guiding diverse teams and stakeholders.

Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.

title: Product Expert - Clinical Data Management - India
description:

+ AI & Digital transformation
+ Risk-based decision making
+ Regulatory compliance
+ A culture of continuous improvement
+ Excellence across the pharmaceutical industry

**What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS products, staying up to date with the latest features and communicating Product roadmap directions.

* Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations.
* Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication.
* Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years working in the Clinical Management space, usually from Product Management, Consulting or Professional Services/Implementation roles
* Recent hands-on experience with Veeva EDC and/or Veeva DQS. Do not apply if you do not have this experience.
* Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations
* Ability to understand Product Vision, Technical Specifications and Software Development Documentation, and translate them into language and content for both business and technical stakeholder
* Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote (including software demonstrations and presentations).
* Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
* A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features solve clinical trials challenges.
* Self-directed team player with a positive attitude.
* Willingness to travel between 15-30%.
* Based in India.

* SQL knowledge

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
**About MasterControl:**
MasterControl Inc. is a leading provider of cloud-based quality and compliance software for life sciences and other regulated industries. Our mission is the same as that of our customers to bring life-changing products to more people sooner. The MasterControl Platform helps organizations digitize, automate and connect quality and compliance processes across the regulated product development life cycle. Over 1,000 companies worldwide rely on MasterControl solutions to achieve new levels of operational excellence across product development, clinical trials, regulatory affairs, quality management, supply chain, manufacturing and postmarket surveillance. For more information, visit www.mastercontrol.com.
  
  
**SUMMARY**
The Customer Support Engineer (CSE) provides in-depth application technical support to MasterControl customers. The CSE carries out troubleshooting and root cause analysis while resolving advanced technical issues for our customers. CSEs work with fellow team members, service consultants, sales operations, and other company resources to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty. CSEs act as the customer's first point of contact and are responsible for the identification of software defects as well as the reporting of such to development, while providing interim solutions when available and necessary.
  
  
This position works with other internal resources to ensure that issues are resolved in a timely fashion. CSEs follow technical support industry-standard best practices, concepts, and procedures. A certain degree of creativity and latitude is required. Full product training will be part of the onboarding process for the successful candidate
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Exceeding customer expectations by providing a tailored service experience.
* Identify and resolve customer issues via incoming calls, emails, etc.
* Provide customers with knowledge regarding software functionality and best practices.
* Identify and reproduce software defects for submission to development.
* Provide Customers with root cause analysis and in-depth troubleshooting.
* Meet and exceed Service Level Agreements through effective incident management.
* Writing Technical Documentation (i.e. Knowledge Base Articles).
* Contributes to the departments' Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
* Performs software implementation, installation, and upgrades to MasterControl customers.
* Updates and maintains reports for customers and key internal contacts.
* Provides backup support to other CSE team members.
* Works directly with escalation engineers to assure resolution of critical customer issues.
* Provide and participate in technical training and knowledge transfer for new or complex products.
* Contribute to overall content and quality of knowledge base utilizing the Knowledge-Centered Support principles.
* As directed, performs special projects.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Excellent customer relationship and advocacy skills.
* Advanced application troubleshooting skills.
* Database management knowledge / MS SQL experience required.
* Attention to detail.
* Professional-level writing and communication skills.
* Professional English language, speaking/writing skills
* LDAP & Active Directory experience / knowledge desirable
* Understanding virtual environments. Strong experience desirable.
* Programming experience / knowledge (Java Script, HTML) helpful
* Proficient with Claude Code or similar

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS**

* May work a variety of schedule hours, as required
* Must be willing to work USA hours of operation on a consistent basis
* Travel may be required

**Why Work Here?**
#WhyWorkAnywhereElse?
  
  
MasterControl is a place where Exceptional Teams come together to do their best work. In fact, hiring Exceptional Teams is a core value of ours. MasterControl employees are surrounded by intelligent, motivated, and collaborative individuals. We like to call it #TheBestTeamOnThePlanet.
  
  
We work hard to develop and challenge our employees' skillsets, recognize their contributions, encourage professional development, and offer a one-of-a-kind culture. This is why we say #WhyWorkAnywhereElse?
  
  
MasterControl could be your next (and last) career move!
  
  
Here are some of the benefits MasterControl employees enjoy:
  
  

* Competitive compensation
* Schedule flexibility
* Fitness clubs (you get paid to have fun and be active!)
* Company parties and employee recognition programs
* Wellness programs
* Much, much more!

title: Technical writer
description:
**About Us**
Planful is the pioneer of financial performance management cloud software. The Planful platform, which helps businesses drive peak financial performance, is used around the globe to streamline business-wide planning, budgeting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics. Planful's award-winning AI capabilities accelerate decision-making, helping Planful users in over 100 countries close faster, accelerate cycle times, increase productivity, and improve accuracy. Planful is a private company with more than 1,500 customers, including Bose, Boston Red Sox, Five Guys, Grafton Plc, Gousto, and Specialized, and is backed by Vector Capital, a leading global private equity firm. Learn more at Planful.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Technical Content Writer to join our Content team and own content for our AI-first platform. This is a build-from-the-ground-up opportunity: redefining how our users interact with AI-driven planning and analytics, and the content you create will shape how customers understand, trust, and adopt AI-native workflows — from conversational interfaces to autonomous agents and AI-generated insights.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You'll work in tight loops with Product Managers to understand what's shipping and why, with UX to make sure in-product language is clear and consistent, and with Engineers to accurately document how the AI capabilities actually work under the hood. You'll also be expected to work at AI-native speed: using Claude and other AI tools as a core part of your own workflow to draft, iterate, and scale content quality — while applying your subject-matter judgment, editorial standards, and domain expertise to everything that ships.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants to help define what great content looks like for an AI-first product, not just document features after the fact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end content for AI-Platform, including in-product AI guidance (prompts, suggested actions, agent explanations), onboarding flows, release notes, and help documentation
* Partner closely with PMs to get early visibility into the roadmap and translate new AI capabilities into clear, accurate, user-facing content
* Collaborate with UX/Product Design on UI text, conversational flows, empty states, and error messaging for AI-driven interactions, ensuring tone and terminology stay consistent as the product evolves
* Work directly with Engineering to understand model behavior, limitations, and system design well enough to write content that's technically accurate — including how AI outputs are generated, their confidence/limitations, and any human-in-the-loop steps
* Use Claude and other AI writing tools as a primary part of your workflow to draft, restructure, and scale content, while maintaining rigorous human review for accuracy, tone, and domain correctness
* Develop and maintain a scalable content strategy for the AI-first platform, including reusable content patterns/templates for recurring AI features
* Produce release content for the monthly Agile release cycle (release notes, known issues, release highlights)
* Continuously audit existing content against product changes, flagging where AI behavior updates require content updates
* Help define content guidelines/voice standards for writing about AI features (e.g., how to describe confidence levels, model limitations, and autonomous actions to users)

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3-6 years of experience researching, writing, and editing content for a software application in an Agile environment
* Demonstrated experience writing content for AI/ML-powered features or products (conversational UI, generative AI outputs, recommendation/agent systems, etc.)
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude or similar LLM-based tools) as part of a content production workflow — drafting, editing, summarizing, or repurposing content at scale
* Comfort working directly with Engineering to understand technical/AI system behavior well enough to write about it accurately
* Experience partnering with UX/Product Design on in-product copy and interaction content
* Experience with wiki-based, industry-standard documentation tools (e.g., Confluence, Document360)
* Finance, EPM, multi-dimensional modeling, or planning software domain expertise is a strong plus
* Experience creating API documentation is a plus
* Experience with onboarding tools such as Pendo or WalkMe is a plus

Key Behaviors
  
  

* AI-fluent – comfortable using AI tools to accelerate content production without sacrificing quality, accuracy, or judgment
* Cross-functional – builds strong working relationships with PMs, UX, and Engineering, and knows how to pull the right context from each
* Proactive – makes things happen instead of waiting for direction; flags content gaps before they become problems
* Detail-oriented – manages multiple concurrent workstreams and releases with precision
* Customer-focused – keeps the end user's understanding and trust in AI features front of mind
* Accountability – owns tasks and outcomes end-to-end
* Team player – collaborates and shares learnings with the broader Content team

Why Planful
  
  
Planful Exists To Enrich The World By Helping Our Customers And Our People Achieve Peak Performance. To Foster The Best-in-class Work We're So Proud Of, We've Created a Best-in-class Culture, Including
  
  

* Volunteer days, Birthday PTO, and company-wide Wellness Days
* Supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave
* Office hubs in Hyderabad and Indore, with home office setup allowance and monthly Wi-Fi/cell phone reimbursements
* Employee Resource Groups like Women of Planful, Parents of Planful, and more
* People Programs that foster connection and wellbeing, such as Movember, Summer Wellness, Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and Hispanic Heritage Month

title: Technical Writer (MarTech & Data Platforms)
description:
JD and Sourcing Kit: Technical Writer (MarTech & Data Platforms)
  
  
Oct 23, 2026 @Quadricit
  
  
Role summary
  
  
Quadric IT is hiring a senior Technical Writer with 12 to 15 years of experience as a full-time employee at our Hyderabad delivery center. You will document marketing technology platforms (Salesforce Data 360 and Marketing Cloud) and the data pipelines, APIs and integrations behind them for Quadric's client programs. The person writes controlled documents that engineers, marketers and auditors rely on, works with minimal supervision, and deals directly with senior technical stakeholders.
  
  
Item
  
  
Detail
  
  
Title
  
  
Technical Writer (MarTech & Data Platforms), Senior
  
  
Employer
  
  
Quadric Information Technology Private Limited
  
  
Employment type
  
  
Full-time, permanent
  
  
Location
  
  
Hyderabad, onsite or hybrid (both options available)

12 to 15 years in technical writing, ideally in regulated or enterprise settings

Recruiter note, not for the posted ad: the reference role is written at mid level with 5+ years. Asking for 12 to 15 years makes this a senior hire. Salary is not a constraint for the right candidate, so do not screen out on expected CTC, and keep the advertised line as "highly competitive".
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
The writer owns documentation for the MarTech stack from first interview to approved, versioned document.
  
  

* Document MarTech platforms: create and maintain user guides, configuration guides and process documentation for Salesforce Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud), Salesforce Marketing Cloud and connected tools.
* Document data flows: describe data pipelines, data models, ingestion and transformation logic, identity resolution, segmentation and activation, with data lineage diagrams.
* Document APIs and integrations: write clear REST and SOAP API documentation, covering endpoints, authentication, request and response examples, error handling and integration specifications.
* Produce controlled documents: author SOPs, work instructions, system descriptions, release notes and change documentation in line with GDocP and company quality standards.
* Collaborate with SMEs: interview developers, data engineers, architects and marketers independently, then validate the content with them.
* Maintain the document lifecycle: manage versioning, reviews, approvals, periodic updates and archiving in a document management system.
* Support compliance: make sure documents support audit readiness (GxP where applicable, GDPR, privacy, consent management, data governance).
* Standardize content: define templates, style guides and a reusable knowledge base, and recommend improvements to documentation processes.
* Guide others: give informal guidance to colleagues and contributors on documentation standards and best practices.

Required qualifications
  
  
Candidates must meet all of these; the first two are the quickest screens.
  
  

* 12 to 15 years of technical writing experience, with at least 5 in a regulated or enterprise environment.
* Working knowledge of Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) and ALCOA+ principles.
* Proven record of independently documenting complex technical systems end to end.
* Ability to learn enterprise platforms quickly and turn them into clear documentation.
* Solid grasp of data and integration concepts: data models, APIs (REST and SOAP), JSON and XML, ETL and ELT, data pipelines.
* Excellent written English, strong attention to detail and the ability to simplify complex topics.
* Experience creating diagrams in tools such as Visio, Lucidchart or draw.io.
* Strong stakeholder management, including comfort challenging and clarifying input from senior technical staff.

Preferred qualifications
  
  
These raise a profile's rank but are not hard filters.
  
  

* Exposure to Salesforce products (Data 360, Marketing Cloud) or other MarTech and CDP tools; Trailhead badges or Salesforce certification is a plus.
* Experience documenting APIs with Postman, Swagger or OpenAPI.
* Ability to read basic SQL, JSON or code snippets.
* Knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, consent management and data privacy requirements.
* Experience in pharma, life sciences or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV or CSA).
* Experience with Confluence, SharePoint, Veeva Vault, MadCap Flare or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Agile and DevOps workflows (Jira, Git-based docs, docs-as-code).
* Experience using AI-assisted documentation tools with strong review discipline.

Key competencies
  
  

* Autonomy: manages own workload and priorities with minimal supervision.
* Technical curiosity: quickly learns new platforms and architectures.
* Stakeholder management: works effectively across IT, marketing, data and quality teams.
* Accuracy and integrity: upholds data integrity and documentation standards.
* Ownership: self-driven, organized, and able to manage multiple deliverables.

Sourcing kit

Boolean string
  
  
Core
  
  
("technical writer" OR "senior technical writer" OR "principal technical writer" OR "documentation lead") AND (Salesforce OR "Data Cloud" OR "Data 360" OR "Marketing Cloud" OR MarTech OR CDP)
  
  
Regulated
  
  
("technical writer" OR "documentation") AND (GxP OR GDocP OR ALCOA OR "21 CFR Part 11" OR CSV OR pharma OR "life sciences") AND (API OR "data pipeline" OR integration)
  
  
API and data
  
  
("technical writer" OR "API documentation") AND (OpenAPI OR Swagger OR Postman) AND (ETL OR "data model" OR "data lineage" OR SQL)
  
  
Tools
  
  
("technical writer") AND (Confluence OR SharePoint OR "Veeva Vault" OR MadCap OR Flare) AND (Visio OR Lucidchart OR draw.io)
  
  
**Where to look:**
pharma and life-science global capability centres in Hyderabad, Salesforce implementation partners, large IT services firms with documentation practices, and CROs with data platform teams.
  
  
**Titles to include:**
Senior Technical Writer, Principal Technical Writer, Documentation Manager, Lead Content Developer, Information Developer, Technical Documentation Specialist, Validation Documentation Lead.
  
  
**Signals to favor:**
stable tenure with a growth path, availability within 30 days (buy-out support possible for the right candidate), willingness to work from Hyderabad, and a portfolio or sanitized samples on request.

title: Type Certification Engineer – UAV / Drones
description:
**Company: Drogo Drones Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location: Hyderabad, Telangana**

**Experience: 1–3 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**About the Role**

Drogo Drones is looking for a Type Certification Engineer with experience or strong

knowledge of UAV/drone certification, regulatory compliance, technical documentation,

and testing processes.

The selected candidate will be responsible for coordinating and supporting the DGCA Type

Certification process for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS), including preparation of

technical documentation, compliance evidence, test coordination, and interaction with

internal engineering teams and certification stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Manage and support UAS Type Certification activities in accordance with

applicable DGCA requirements and certification standards.

• Prepare, review, organize, and maintain certification-related technical

documentation.

• Develop and maintain compliance checklists, compliance matrices, test

reports, design documents, manuals, and supporting evidence.

• Coordinate with design, avionics, embedded systems, mechanical, propulsion,

flight-test, quality, and manufacturing teams to obtain certification evidence.

• Support preparation and execution of ground tests and flight tests required for

certification.

• Document test procedures, observations, results, deviations, and corrective

actions.

• Maintain configuration control and traceability between UAV design requirements,

test evidence, and certification documentation.

• Identify certification gaps and coordinate closure of observations/nonconformities.

• Support documentation related to UAV subsystems including flight controller,

propulsion system, communication system, navigation system, batteries,

payloads, and safety systems.

• Coordinate with testing agencies, certification bodies, and regulatory stakeholders

as required.

• Monitor changes in applicable DGCA UAS regulations, certification

requirements, and industry standards.

• Support design changes, product upgrades, and certification impact assessments.

• Maintain complete certification records for audits and future product variants.

title: Associate Support Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. For more information, please visit solera.com.
  
  
**The Role**
The IT Service Desk Specialist serves as the first point of contact for employees seeking technical assistance and support from Global IT. As a member of the Service Desk team, you will provide exceptional customer service while diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving a wide range of IT issues and service requests.
  
  
In this role, you will support users through multiple channels, including phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently or escalated appropriately. You will be responsible for delivering a positive support experience while maintaining service levels, documenting activities accurately, and following established IT processes and procedures.
  
  
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically inclined, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. They are able to communicate effectively with users at all levels of the organization, demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and take ownership of issues from initial contact through resolution or escalation.
  
  
As the face of Global IT support, the Service Desk Specialist plays a critical role in maintaining productivity across the business by providing reliable technical assistance, contributing to knowledge management, and collaborating with teams across the organization to deliver exceptional service.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Core Technical Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for all IT incidents and service requests through phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.
* Log, classify, prioritize, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and requests in accordance with established SLA and ITIL practices.
* Provide first-level technical support for:
* Windows and macOS operating systems
* Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Password resets and account unlocks
* Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
* Basic Active Directory and Azure Entra user account issues
* Hardware and software troubleshooting
* VPN and remote access connectivity
* Perform initial diagnosis and troubleshooting to achieve first-contact resolution whenever possible.

* Create and update knowledge base documentation to support continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

* Collaborate with IT teams globally to ensure seamless support and service delivery.

**What You’ll Bring**
This person needs to come from a multi-disciplined background and be able to work at all levels within the company on any IT problem or project.
  
  
**Specifically:**
**Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Windows 10/11 and macOS.

* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.

* VPN connectivity

* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve common hardware, software, and account-related issues.

* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with global teams.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Associate degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, or similar certifications are considered a plus.

title: Regulatory AI and Content Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
Title -
**Regulatory AI and Content Specialist**
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
  
  
Location : Hyderabad
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
**Mission**
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
  
  
As part of Roche’s Product Development (PD), Product Development Regulatory (PDR) strengthens regulatory capabilities through scalable models and sustainable solutions that support evolving regulatory requirements, global drug development priorities, and continuous innovation, leveraging automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and emerging technologies.
  
  
**The Position**
As a Regulatory AI & Content Specialist, you will serve as the bridge between Pharma Development Regulatory (PDR) , content management, and AI-enabled technology, driving the digital transformation of regulatory content within the PDR organization. In this role, you will leverage your understanding of regulatory documents, content structures, and submission requirements to design, standardize, and optimize reusable regulatory content for AI-powered authoring and automation. You will play a key role in setting up, configuring and managing content use cases and templates within the in house GenAI powered platform enabling efficient, consistent, and compliant regulatory document generation for a global regulatory organization.
  
  
You will also work directly alongside document authors supporting, and where needed leading, the drafting of regulatory documents using AI-enabled authoring capabilities ensuring that what the platform produces is genuinely usable, high quality, and submission-ready.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Regulatory Content & AI Expertise
  
  

* Have a strong understanding of regulatory documents across the drug development lifecycle, including clinical, non-clinical, CMC, and CTD-based submissions
* Apply knowledge of Generative AI, structured content, and regulatory authoring principles to support AI-enabled content creation and document standardization
* Stay current with evolving regulatory requirements, AI capabilities, and industry best practices

Regulatory Content Management & Platform Management
  
  

* Analyze regulatory documents and convert them into standardized templates, reusable content components, and structured content models within the in house GenAI powered platform
* Configure and maintain templates, metadata, and content assets to enable efficient, compliant, and AI-assisted regulatory authoring
* Support content governance through template lifecycle management, version control, and content quality

Platform Enablement & Collaboration
  
  

* Serve as a super user for the GenAI powered platform, providing business support, user enablement, and contribute towards continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform adoption and operational efficiency
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, and release readiness activities for new platform capabilities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across PDR, PD, PT (Pharma Technical) and RDT (Roche Digital Technology) colleagues to align regulatory content with business and platform requirements
* Identify opportunities to improve regulatory content development through AI, automation, and low-code/no-code capabilities

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Regulatory Affairs, or a related discipline
* 4–6 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations, Regulatory Writing, Medical Writing, or a related pharmaceutical role
* Experience in leading/ supporting clinical or marketing authorization submissions, with a good understanding of the drug development lifecycle, ICH guidelines, CTD/eCTD structure, and regulatory expectations of major health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or Health Canada)
* Ability to critically review and interpret regulatory, clinical, and safety documents, and translate them into standardized, structured content for AI-enabled authoring
* Knowledge of Generative AI, AI-enabled content authoring, and digital technologies, with an interest in applying them to regulatory processes
* Experience with structured content authoring, document templating, content management, Regulatory Information Management (RIM), or AI-enabled authoring platforms; familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms is desirable
* Experience in leading/ supporting digital platform implementation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), or business validation activities is preferred
* Excellent analytical, written communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with a continuous learning mindset and attention to detail.

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Maintenance Digitalization Specialist
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
Could you be the full-time Digital Maintenance Engineer in our Maintenance Digitalisation team we’re looking for?
  
  
**Your future role**
Take on a new challenge and apply your analytical and engineering expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative, detail-oriented, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
You'll act as the bridge between the Maintenance world and the Data domain, identifying optimisation opportunities and implementing them through the use of digital technologies. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as Maintenance Operations, Fleet Support Centers, and Regional Service Engineering), master digital tools, and drive the deployment of new processes from conception to adoption.
  
  
You’ll specifically take care of creating and maintaining an inventory of digital rules and reports, but also support training programs to enable regional resources to fully utilise digital maintenance tools.
  
  
We’ll look to you for:
  
  

* Mastering digital tools like HealthHub, TrainScanner, Track Tracer, and others to support maintenance projects.
* Understanding maintenance operations, lifecycle costs (LCC), and depot planning to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Developing and maintaining an inventory of HealthHub rules and reports, ensuring their effectiveness and traceability.
* Creating “starter packs” for new Rolling Stock Maintenance projects to adopt best practices.
* Managing and delivering a training curriculum to regional teams, ensuring content is relevant and impactful.
* Supporting value assessment and tracking benefits achieved through digital tool deployments.
* Assisting with the roll-out of methodologies and supporting trained regional resources.

**All About You**
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
  
  

* Degree in Engineering, Master of Science, or equivalent.
* Experience or understanding of maintenance industry needs and operational constraints.
* Knowledge of Rolling Stock or Railway Signaling products/subsystems.
* Familiarity with condition-based maintenance (CBM) and prognostics and health monitoring (PHM).
* A proactive, autonomous, and challenge-driven mindset.
* Detail-oriented and solution-driven work ethic.
* Excellent team player skills with a supportive attitude and eagerness to learn from others.

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
  
  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies in rail signalling and maintenance analytics.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of transportation.
* Utilise our flexible and dynamic working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards leadership and specialized technical roles.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

description:
