* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* 4-6 years experience in business process analysis, operations improvement, or data management (finance/billing domain preferred)
* Strong process mapping and optimization skills (Lean, Six Sigma Green Belt preferred)
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, macros, Power Query)
* Experience with data quality frameworks, validation rules, and reconciliation processes
* Familiarity with automation tools (UiPath, Power Automate, or similar RPA platforms)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills (ability to work with LoB operations teams)
* SAP FI/AR knowledge helpful

**Key Compentencies**

* Process mapping and optimization (SIPOC, value stream analysis, workflow design)
* Data analysis and validation (quality frameworks, error taxonomies, reconciliation)
* Business analysis (requirements gathering, solution design, feasibility assessment)
* Stakeholder collaboration and facilitation (workshops, training, change management)
* Documentation and knowledge management (SOPs, templates, user guides)
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Communication (translating technical data concepts for operational audiences)

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

title: Engineer - Controls Platform NPI
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. **Education\***
CA/CPA, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance

3 - 5 years experience

11:30 am to 8:30 pm

MUM/HYD/CHN

title: Senior Manager, AIN Documentation, Content Create and Automation (DCCA)
description:
Location: India | Scope: Global service supporting Amgen sites
  
  
Under minimal direction, the Senior Manager, DCCA leads a DS, DP or FDP team based in India that creates and revises controlled GMP documentation for Amgen sites globally. The role owns the service-delivery model that enables reliable, compliant, and accurate documentation support - delivering to agreed service-level agreements while driving right-first-time quality, predictable turnaround, and continuous improvement. Hours for this role may vary based on global time zones, which could include hybrid hours, on call requirements, and flexible working hours.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**Global Service Delivery and SLA Management**

* Lead the daily operation of the global GMP documentation service for DS, DP, or FDP, ensuring requests are received, clarified, prioritized, assigned, completed, and handed off in accordance with defined service-level agreements.
* Establish transparent intake, triage, prioritization, and escalation practices that balance site criticality, compliance risk, business impact, and available capacity.
* Develop and maintain capacity plans, workload forecasts, staffing models, and recovery plans that enable the team to meet commitments across supported sites and time zones.
* Own performance management routines and dashboards for on-time delivery, right-first-time quality, cycle time, queue aging, rework, customer feedback, and resource utilization.
* Identify service risks early, communicate impacts and options clearly, and escalate constraints with proposed mitigation and recovery actions.

**GMP Documentation Quality and Compliance**

* Ensure document creation and revision activities comply with applicable global and local GMP requirements, good documentation practices, data-integrity expectations, controlled-document procedures, and approved change-control processes.
* Set and maintain standards for document structure, technical writing, accuracy, traceability, version control, formatting, and review readiness to prevent defects before delivery.
* Oversee authoring and revision of controlled GMP documents, such as SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing and laboratory records, technical reports, and associated attachments, based on approved site inputs and change requirements.
* Oversee the content creation of training materials used in the manufacturing areas including instructional design.
* Implement appropriate peer review, quality checks, training, and escalation mechanisms to improve right-first-time acceptance and reduce avoidable rework.
* Support inspection and audit readiness; ensure service records, training, and performance evidence are complete, traceable, and review-ready.
* Oversee investigational support within the specific manufacturing domain.

**Global Partnership and Governance**

* Serve as the senior-manager-level liaison between the India documentation team and global site stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, QC, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and other technical functions.
* Create effective governance forums with supported sites to review demand, priorities, service performance, quality trends, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
* Clarify and maintain accountability between the service team and site owners: the service team provides disciplined document development and revision support; site functions retain ownership of technical content, approvals, local requirements, and implementation decisions.
* Resolve complex cross-functional issues that could affect document quality, approval readiness, delivery timing, or compliance, using a risk-based approach.

**People Leadership and Organizational Capability**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team of GMP documentation professionals, technical writers, and/or documentation specialists.
* Establish role clarity, training curricula, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans that build sustainable technical and leadership capability in India.
* Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning while maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and accountable work environment.
* Partner with Human Resources and functional leaders to maintain an adaptable organization that can respond to changing global demand and business priorities.

**Operational Excellence and Strategic Improvement**

* Standardize and continuously improve documentation workflows, templates, authoring practices, quality controls, and digital ways of working across the service.
* Lead cross-site projects and improvement initiatives that increase speed, accuracy, scalability, and customer experience without compromising compliance.
* Manage departmental headcount, training, technology, and operating budgets; optimize resources against the long-range demand plan.
* Represent the documentation service on global teams, task forces, and quality-system initiatives as needed.

Service Performance and Quality Measures
  
  
The leader establishes goals and management routines that keep customer commitments, documentation quality, and compliance visible and balanced.
  
  
**Measure**
**Leadership expectation**
**On-time delivery**
Meet committed site service-level agreements through active planning, workload balancing, and early escalation of risks.
  
  
**Right-first-time quality**
Increase documents accepted without material rework by applying defined authoring standards, peer review, and quality checks before handoff.
  
  
**Cycle time and queue health**
Monitor turnaround time, aging, backlog, and prioritization to maintain a predictable global service.
  
  
**Compliance performance**
Maintain adherence to controlled-document, change-control, data-integrity, training, and audit-readiness requirements.
  
  
**Customer partnership and capacity**
Use site feedback, demand forecasts, and workload data to improve service reliability and plan resource needs.
  
  
*Service-level targets and acceptance criteria are defined in collaboration with the supported sites and governing quality processes.*
**Basic Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree and 12 to 17 years of experience
  
  
2 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation of resources.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, technical communications, business, or a related field.
* 7+ years of directly related experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical-device, or other regulated GMP environment, including 4+ years leading people, technical writers, documentation specialists, projects, or programs.
* Demonstrated experience developing and revising controlled GMP documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing or laboratory records, and related technical documentation.
* Experience operating a shared service or customer-facing function across multiple sites, cultures, and time zones, with accountability for service-level agreements and delivery metrics.
* Experience with electronic document-management and quality-management systems, document lifecycles, change control, and inspection or audit support.
* Lean, continuous-improvement, project-management, or operational-excellence experience is preferred.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development, and capability building for a diverse technical team.
* Expert technical writing, editing, and review skills; sound judgment to distinguish content clarity, document quality, and compliance risk.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, good documentation practices, data integrity principles, controlled-document requirements, and change-management processes.
* Service-management discipline: intake, prioritization, workload planning, capacity modeling, performance dashboards, and timely risk escalation.
* Ability to influence global stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and operate effectively across time zones.
* Analytical problem solving, continuous-improvement mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage change without compromising quality while demonstrating a commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and Amgen values.

title: Senior Change Management Analyst
description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
The Senior Change Management Analyst is an experienced individual contributor responsible for supporting ITIL-aligned IT change management. Reporting to the Change Manager, the role reviews and coordinates Requests for Change (RFCs), prepares CAB materials, maintains the change calendar, validates implementation readiness, supports stakeholder communications, monitors outcomes, and recommends continual improvements. The role does not own enterprise change policy, manage people, or serve as final approver for high-risk changes unless formally delegated.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support consistent, ITIL-aligned execution of the change process under direction of the Change Manager.
* Review RFCs for completeness, risk, impact, approvals, testing evidence, implementation steps, validation criteria, communications, and rollback planning.
* Coordinate with change owners, technical teams, service owners, release teams, incident management, vendors.
* Maintain accurate change records, calendar entries, meeting notes, decision logs, and audit-ready evidence. Escalate scheduling conflicts, readiness gaps, policy exceptions, high-risk changes, and change-related incidents.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Change Governance and RFC Quality**

* Apply approved change policies, procedures, templates, workflows, risk models, and approval paths in daily change activities.
* Review RFCs for business justification, scope, affected services, dependencies, outage needs, approvals, implementation, validation, and backout plans.
* Return incomplete or unclear records to change owners and document required corrections according to process guidelines.
* Verify correct classification and routing for standard, normal, emergency, expedited, major, minor, vendor release-related, infrastructure, application, cloud, security, and vendor-driven changes.

**CAB and Change Meeting Support**

* Prepare CAB agendas, change summaries, risk highlights, schedule views, meeting materials, and decision documentation.
* Assist the Change Manager with facilitation, timekeeping, risk callouts, notes, follow-up tracking, deferrals, approvals, and action items.
* Escalate high-risk, high-impact, conflicting, business-critical, or poorly documented changes before CAB review.

**Risk, Impact, and Readiness Assessment**

* Evaluate readiness based on service impact, technical complexity, outage duration, customer impact, security exposure, data sensitivity, dependencies, and rollback feasibility.
* Constructively challenge weak implementation plans, inadequate testing evidence, incomplete dependency analysis, missing communications, or unrealistic rollback steps.
* Escalate unresolved concerns, policy exceptions, and changes requiring additional review by service owners, cybersecurity, compliance, release management, or business stakeholders.

**Calendar, Scheduling, and Communications**

* Maintain the enterprise change calendar and monitor maintenance windows, blackout periods, and resource constraints.
* Identify collisions, overlapping outages, resource conflicts, and competing implementation windows; coordinate schedule alignment with release, project, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, vendor, and operations teams.
* Draft and distribute approved communications; ensure service desk and support teams understand outage windows, expected symptoms, business impact, workarounds, and escalation contacts.

**Emergency Change, PIR, Metrics, and Tooling**

* Support emergency changes by verifying urgency, risk, approvals, implementation details, validation, communications, and after-the-fact documentation.
* Support post-implementation reviews for failed, backed-out, emergency, high-risk, major, or incident-causing changes; document lessons learned, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and follow-up status.
* Prepare dashboards, trend summaries, audit evidence, and KPI reporting for success rate, failed changes, emergency volume, unauthorized changes, change-related incidents, approval cycle time, standard adoption, and CAB action closure.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit changes; recommend workflow, notification, dashboard, template, and automation improvements.

**YOUR PROFILE**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5 or more years in IT service management, IT operations, infrastructure support, application support, release management, project coordination, or production support.
* 3 or more years of hands-on experience supporting an enterprise IT change management process.
* Current ITIL certification required, preferably ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience reviewing RFCs, maintaining change calendars, preparing CAB materials, supporting emergency changes, and documenting post-implementation review outcomes.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or comparable ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices, including change enablement, incident, problem, service request, configuration, release, service level, and continual improvement.
* Ability to translate technical information into business impact, risk, operational readiness, and stakeholder communication requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for meeting notes, status updates, process documentation, and stakeholder communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Practitioner: Change Enablement.
* Experience in regulated or audit-driven environments such as Financial Services.
* Experience supporting cloud, hybrid infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, application, database, endpoint, and enterprise platform changes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and automated change approval models.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC1, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar control frameworks.
* Experience creating dashboards and analytics using ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting standard change models, risk scoring frameworks, process training materials, and stakeholder communication templates.

**Required Technical Skills And Core Competencies**

* ITSM and Change: ITIL-aligned workflows, RFC quality, classifications, approvals, calendars, risk assessment, and closure.
* Risk Judgment: Identifies service, business, technical, security, compliance, and scheduling risks before implementation.
* Service Tools: Use ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit change records.
* Process Discipline: Applies governance consistently while keeping the process practical and understandable.
* Technology Ops: Working knowledge of infrastructure, applications, networks, databases, cloud, cybersecurity, endpoints, and production support.
* Accountability: Follows up, maintains accurate records, meets deadlines, and escalates unresolved risks properly.
* Reporting: Create and interpret dashboards, KPI summaries, trend reports, data quality checks, and audit evidence.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Builds effective relationships across technical teams, service owners, vendors, audit, and business stakeholders.
* Documentation: Create clear meeting notes, change summaries, process guidance, work instructions, and communications.
* Communication: Explains technical change activity clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaboration Tools:Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Visio, or equivalent tools.
* Continuous Improvement: Simplifies workflows, standardizes repeatable work, improves templates, and reduces rework.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices

* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan

title: Warehouse Business Process Specialist
description:
The Global Warehousing team enables reliable, efficient and agile Manufacturing and Distribution operations that meet Amgen’s evolving business needs.
  
  
This role supports the quality and effectiveness of Amgen’s warehousing processes by maintaining controlled documents, coordinating defined business continuity and training activities, and collaborating with stakeholders across regions. **Responsibilities**

* Support the review and revision of the Warehouse Global Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and related Business Impact Analysis (BIA).
* Collect and consolidate input from process and site stakeholders and coordinate assigned follow-up actions with the Business Continuity Team.
* Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation for assigned business continuity activities.

**Global Warehousing Training**

* Develop and maintain assigned training content, learning activities, training qualifications and Assignment Vehicles for Global Warehousing processes and systems.
* Act as designated author, editor or administrator for assigned training documents and records in CDOCS and the Learning Management System (LMS), in accordance with approved governance.
* Coordinate the creation, revision and implementation of assigned Learning Activities and Assignment Vehicles with the process owner and Learning & Performance (L&P).
* Collect data and stakeholder feedback to support assessment of training effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain functions and qualified instructors to support timely training delivery.
* Monitor assigned training actions and escalate risks, gaps or overdue items to the responsible owner.

**Stakeholder Collaboration and Improvement**

* Maintain effective working relationships with Warehouse Network stakeholders, Quality, Learning & Performance and Global Distribution.
* Facilitate defined process-documentation or training workshops using established methods and templates.
* Analyze process feedback, document issues and training data to identify improvement opportunities and prepare recommendations for review.
* Plan and deliver assigned activities within agreed timelines, communicating progress, dependencies and risks to the manager or process owner.
* Share lessons learned and reusable materials across the Warehouse Network.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in supply chain, logistics, economics or a related discipline with total 5 to 9 years of experience.
* 2+ years of supply chain, logistics, warehousing, quality systems, document management or related experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated environment.
* At minimum basic GMP knowledge and experience.
* Basic knowledge of ERP and WMS systems, preferably SAP (E)WM.
* Experience documenting business processes, process flows, SOPs, WIs or other Quality Management System documents.
* Experience working with Quality Management Systems and controlled-document processes.
* Working knowledge of business process modelling; experience with Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) is preferred.
* Technical writing skills and strong attention to detail.
* Ability to facilitate structured workshops and coordinate input from cross-functional and geographically diverse stakeholders.
* Interest in learning and development methods, including e-learning; LMS experience is preferred.
* Ability to work independently on defined assignments, manage priorities and escalate matters outside assigned scope.
* Experience working in a matrix-based organization and collaborating within a network.
* Fluency in English in oral and written communication.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

Role Scope and Decision-Making
  
  

* Works within established global processes, quality requirements, governance and priorities.
* Owns the quality and timely completion of assigned deliverables, but not the overall Global Warehousing process, training strategy or business continuity framework.
* Makes routine decisions within assigned document, training and coordination activities and escalates significant compliance, scope or stakeholder decisions to the accountable owner.

title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**

EB1A Experts supports tech professionals in building strong evidence strategies and clear personal narratives for employment-based immigration paths such as EB1A, O1A, and EB2-NIW. The team specializes in transforming dispersed achievements across roles, projects, and recognitions into cohesive, compelling stories of influence, leadership, and impact. By identifying persuasive proof points and organizing supporting materials with intention, EB1A Experts helps clients present structured and credible cases. The company focuses on clarity, ensuring each client’s journey is accurately reflected through narrative and evidence. EB1A Experts provides educational and informational guidance and does not offer legal advice or representation before U.S. immigration authorities.

**Role Summary**

This role is responsible for researching, writing, and submitting scholarly articles to peer-reviewed journals. The writer develops manuscripts across technical and professional fields, identifies journals whose scope and standards match each article, and guides each manuscript through peer review to publication.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Research and write original, well-structured scholarly articles (research papers, review articles, case studies, and perspective pieces) across technical and professional fields.

• Research technical topics in depth and translate complex concepts and data into clear, accurate scholarly writing.

• Review journal aims & scope, author guidelines, and recently published work to assess suitability, and tailor each manuscript to the target journal's structure, style, and citation requirements.

• Conduct literature reviews using academic databases (e.g., Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore) and cite sources accurately.

• Prepare complete submission packages, including cover letters, abstracts, keywords, figures and tables, declarations, and supporting documents.

• Submit manuscripts through journal submission platforms (e.g., Editorial Manager, ScholarOne) and track their status through to a decision.

• Respond to editor and reviewer comments, revise manuscripts, and prepare clear point-by-point response letters.

• Ensure originality and uphold publication-ethics standards, including plagiarism screening and proper attribution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

• Prior experience writing and publishing in peer-reviewed journals, with published papers as evidence (first-author or co-author).

• Master's degree or higher in a technical, scientific, engineering, business, or related discipline (M.Phil/Masters preferred). Candidates with a bachelor's degree and a strong publication record will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of the academic journal ecosystem: aims & scope, peer review, article types, indexing databases, and journal metrics.

• Technical aptitude: able to understand and accurately explain technical concepts across areas such as engineering, computing, data science, life sciences, or business.

• Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to adapt tone and structure to different disciplines and journals.

• Proficiency with reference managers (e.g., Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote) and plagiarism-checking tools (e.g., Turnitin, iThenticate).

• Strong attention to detail, time management, and the ability to handle multiple manuscripts at different stages concurrently.

**Preferred (Not Required)**

• Experience publishing across more than one discipline.

• Prior experience as a scientific or technical writer, journal editor, or peer reviewer.

• Familiarity with LaTeX and journal-specific manuscript templates.

Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Global Job Profile: ECM Service Manager**

**About Us (Enterprise Content Management - ECM)**

We provide our Business Partners with a reliable and comprehensive service for capturing, managing, storing, preserving and retrieving business content and documents that are key to their business functions. We offer two solutions:

· ECMaaS: is a shared content services platform using primarily IBM Cloud Pack for Business Automation (CP4BA) and hosted in Capgemini Azure Cloud.

· ZBOX: is a shared content services platform based on Box SaaS

We offer from Consulting Services, to Project execution and application maintenance for the above shared ECM platforms.

**Your Role:**

As a Service Manager for ECM shared platforms, you’ll play a crucial role in maintaining and evolving our ECMaaS and ZBOX business-critical applications, with focus on APAC region.

You would be the main contact person for our APAC clients and you’ll be empowered to make decisions, collaborate globally, ensuring stability and reliability for thousand of users.

Your main responsibilities would be:

* ECM Service Manager for ECMaaS APAC applications
* ECM Service Manager for ZBOX APAC applications
* Act as the central point of contact for consolidating and coordinating demand across the region, with the aim of driving regional growth and expansion.
* Manage ECMaaS and ZBOX small-medium work orders, and support other large platform projects (i.e Platform Upgrades, etc) if required.
* Administer ZBOX APAC applications.

You’ll work with colleagues who are both proactive and genuinely supportive, fostering an environment where teamwork and shared success are at the core of our ways of working. Your responsibility can grow in line with the value you bring and your proactive approach—meaning your ideas, initiative, and drive are recognized and rewarded. We value your expertise, support your growth, and trust you with responsibilities that matter.

This is an individual Contributor (IC) role, where you will expected to work as an independent contributor, taking ownership of service delivery, driving operational excellence, and collaborating with several Zurich teams and third party vendors to ensure stable and reliable platform operations.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Oversee the delivery of high-quality IT support services to our internal stakeholders, ensuring we meet service level agreements (SLAs) and maintain a stable production environment. Also play a key role in managing changes, security, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead management communications for the business for service (e.g. incident alerts, change freezes etc.), as well as escalations, and demand (new opportunities).
* Manage small-medium work orders, and support other large platform projects (i.e Platform Upgrades, etc).
* Prepare monthly reporting and handle monthly service reviews with the business unit counterparts
* Identify service improvement actions and work with the required parties for the implementation of the same.
* Identify and implement continuous improvements to our support processes and tools.
* Work with the business unit and Global Disaster Recovery teams to ensure that the disaster recovery capability meets the global DR requirements, including planning, performance of testing, communication and restoration of services in response to a major outage or disaster.
* Ensure internal and external providers are compliant with regulatory requirements and provide assistance and support for audits, where applicable.
* Drive daily use of Zurich approved AI tools and accelerators to support daily activities (e.g., requirements review, summaries or analyze historical incident tickets, simplify reporting, detects outdated documentation, identify components with high change sensitivity, etc).
* Ensure that the ZBOX applications in the region are up and running. This includes raising support tickets with the Box partner when an incidents originates from the Box SaaS solution itself.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The
**Service Improvement Analyst – Digital Workplace Services**
is responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and driving service improvement opportunities across the Digital Workplace Services portfolio. This role focuses on enhancing the end-user experience, improving service performance, optimizing operational processes, and increasing adoption of modern workplace technologies.
  
  
Leveraging
**ITIL, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Digital Employee Experience (DEX)**
principles, the analyst partners with service owners, engineering teams, operations teams, vendors, and clients to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and measure outcomes. The role requires a strong combination of analytical skills, customer focus, business acumen, and technical understanding of modern workplace services such as Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and end-user computing services.
  
  
The Service Improvement Analyst will lead improvement initiatives across multiple clients and business functions while ensuring service delivery aligns with business objectives, user expectations, and operational excellence standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Improvement & Digital Workplace Optimization
  
  

* Lead the development and execution of service improvement initiatives across Digital Workplace Services in partnership with Service Excellence Leads, Service Owners, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Analyze service performance, user experience data, operational metrics, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive continual improvement programs focused on enhancing employee productivity, service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Establish improvement roadmaps aligned with Digital Workplace Services strategy and business objectives.
* Support the adoption and optimization of workplace technologies including Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint services, mobility solutions, and digital employee experience tools.
* Utilize Digital Employee Experience (DEX) insights, service analytics, and user sentiment data to prioritize and implement service improvements.

Process Excellence & Operational Effectiveness
  
  

* Develop a thorough understanding of existing Digital Workplace processes, workflows, and service delivery models to identify optimization opportunities.
* Create and maintain operational process documentation including: Process maps and flowcharts Standard operating procedures (SOPs) Capacity and utilization studies Time and motion studies Standard work documentation Cycle-time and workflow analysis
* Lead process redesign initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, standardization, and service quality.
* Coordinate and track improvement activities resulting from Kaizen workshops, problem-solving sessions, and operational reviews.
* Implement Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, and Continuous Improvement methodologies to drive measurable outcomes.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights
  
  

* Define, monitor, and report on key Digital Workplace Services KPIs and SLAs, including: Service Desk performance End-user experience metrics Incident and request trends Availability and reliability metrics Adoption and utilization metrics Customer satisfaction (CSAT) Employee experience measures
* Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause analysis and trend analysis to proactively address recurring service issues.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making to recommend service enhancements and operational improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional service improvement initiatives involving Operations, Engineering, Service Management, Product Teams, Vendors, and Client stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and point of contact for service improvement programs and transformation efforts.
* Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and continuous improvement sessions with business and technical teams.
* Deliver Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Continual Improvement, and service management training and awareness sessions.
* Mentor Yellow and Green Belt practitioners and support the organization's continuous improvement culture.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize and implement approved improvements that increase service value, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

Governance & Best Practices
  
  

* Promote and enforce ITIL and continual improvement best practices across Digital Workplace Services.
* Support service governance activities, operational reviews, and improvement boards.
* Ensure improvement initiatives are measured, documented, and sustained through appropriate governance and change management practices.
* Drive the identification, adoption, and continuous improvement of scalable end-to-end service delivery processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Service Improvement, Process Improvement, Business Analysis, Service Management, or a related role.
* 2+ years of experience applying Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence methodologies.
* Experience supporting or improving Digital Workplace Services environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of identifying improvement opportunities and delivering measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience documenting and optimizing business and operational processes.
* Experience working cross-functionally within complex organizational environments.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with global and remote teams.
* Excellent reporting, dashboard creation, and performance measurement experience.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Teams, and Visio.
* Strong understanding of service management principles, KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher-level ITIL certification.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms such as Nexthink, Lakeside, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management, Intune, Windows Services, Collaboration Platforms, and Modern Workplace technologies.
* Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow, and service analytics platforms.
* Experience in managed services or enterprise IT environments.

Estimated Pay Range:

title: AI Product Technical Specialist
description:
**Job Title:**
Product Technical Specialist
  
  
**Location: 100% Remote (India) | US Shift**
US Pacific Timezone, working hours may vary in the hours of 5am-5pm PT depending on current staffing demands
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Product Technical Specialist, you will be the trusted technical expert for our customers, ensuring they have a seamless and reliable experience with our SaaS platform. This role is for a natural problem-solver who thrives on diving deep into complex technical issues. You will be the backbone of our support operations, diagnosing and resolving intricate problems related to our AWS-hosted environment, networking configurations, and integrated phone systems. You are energized by a fast-paced environment and are passionate about providing world-class support through phone, email, and chat, ready to tackle any challenge that comes your way, including participation in a rotating on-call schedule to provide critical support.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality, real-time technical support to customers via phone, email, and chat, managing multiple issues simultaneously.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and tune AI systems to ensure chatbot and voice bot interactions remain highly accurate and effective for credit union members.
* Explain complex AI functionalities, configurations, and system options directly to clients to ensure they maximize the value of our platform.
* Identify AI product bugs and anomalies, clearly articulating the underlying technical issues and their direct client impact to Product and Engineering teams.
* Act as an internal AI subject matter expert, creating documentation and passing along your specialized knowledge to upscale the rest of the support team.
* Lead technical troubleshooting sessions with customer IT teams, diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to networking (VPNs, firewalls, whitelisting), cloud infrastructure (AWS), and integrated phone systems.
* Utilize Zendesk to manage, prioritize, and document customer support tickets from initial contact through to resolution.
* Analyze application, server, and AI logs to identify performance bottlenecks and root causes of failures.
* Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to provide after-hours and weekend support for critical, service-impacting incidents.
* Develop and maintain internal and customer-facing support documentation, including knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of experience in a technical support role for an Enterprise SaaS product.
* Proven experience working with or supporting AI/Automation technologies (e.g., Natural Language Processing, Chatbots, Voice bots, or AI-driven analytics).

**Technical Proficiency**

* Deep understanding of how AI systems work, including intent tuning, conversational flows, and AI training methodologies.
* Experience analyzing and troubleshooting AI-driven chatbots, voice bots, and data analytics tools.
* Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk for ticketing and customer support.
* Deep understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and protocols like SFTP and HTTPS.
* Proven experience working with cloud environments, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., Lex, Connect, EC2, S3, VPC).
* Familiarity with troubleshooting VoIP/telephony systems and understanding common communication routing issues.

**Core Skills**

* Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for tackling complex AI and technical challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage high-priority tasks, and perform effectively under pressure.
* Experience with log analysis tools (e.g., Kibana, CloudWatch) and network traffic analysis tools (e.g., Fiddler, Wireshark).
* Ability to remain organized and detail-oriented while managing a high volume of support interactions.
* Must be willing and able to participate in a rotating on-call schedule.

**Why join us?**

* Be part of a dynamic, high-growth tech company with an exciting future.
* Work in a collaborative and supportive environment that values innovation and employee experience.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including healthcare, 401(k), and professional development opportunities.
* An opportunity to make a direct impact in shaping peoples direct access to financial services by enabling community financial institutions to efficiently communicate with their membership base.

**About Eltropy (www.eltropy.com)**
Eltropy is on a mission to disrupt the way people access financial services. Eltropy enables financial institutions to digitally engage in a secure and compliant way. Using our world-class digital communications platform, community financial institutions can improve operations, engagement and productivity. CFIs (Community Banks and Credit Unions) use Eltropy to communicate with consumers via Text, Video, Secure Chat, co-browsing, screen sharing and chatbot technology — all integrated in a single platform bolstered by AI, skill-based routing and other contact center capabilities.
  
  
**Eltropy Values**

* Customers are our North Star
* No Fear - Tell the truth
* Team of Owners

Eltropy is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Change and CMDB Coordinator
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of the role**
The Change Coordinator is the hands-on operator of the change management process, running the day-to-day flow of changes through Jira Service Management under the direction of the Change Manager. The role keeps changes moving: logging and quality-checking requests, coordinating risk assessment, scheduling, chasing approvals, sending deployment notifications, and driving each change to closure.
  
  
Where the Change Manager owns policy, authority and governance, the Coordinator owns execution and momentum. It is a highly organised, detail-focused, delivery-oriented role and the first point of contact for change requesters. The Coordinator prepares and services the CAB but does not chair it or hold final authorisation authority.
  
  
**Scope**

* Day-to-day operation of the change management process for infrastructure, cloud (AWS) and production changes recorded in JSM (KEYCAB project).
* The change calendar / forward schedule of change, deployment windows and change-related communications.
* Preparation, coordination and minuting of CAB and ECAB meetings.
* Accurate, up-to-date change records and status through the JSM workflow.
* Day-to-day coordination of the infrastructure CMDB — keeping CI records accurate and changes linked to the CIs they affect.

**Key Responsibilities**
Logging & quality control
  
  

* Receive and log CAB Requests; check each for completeness — description, reason, risk, rollback plan, testing evidence and impact.
* Return incomplete requests to requesters and coach them on what good looks like.
* Ensure each change is correctly categorised (standard / minor / major / emergency) with the Change Manager where needed.

Coordination & scheduling
  
  

* Maintain the forward schedule of change; book deployment windows and flag clashes, dependencies and freeze periods.
* Chase and track technical approval (Tech Lead) and change approval (Senior PM); ensure approvals are recorded before deployment.
* Coordinate the parties involved in each change and confirm readiness ahead of the window.

Communication
  
  

* Prepare and issue deployment notifications to the relevant distribution lists ahead of each change.
* Keep stakeholders informed of schedule, status and any changes or slips.
* Act as day-to-day point of contact for change requesters and implementers.

CAB support
  
  

* Build the CAB agenda, circulate the change list, and prepare supporting information for the Change Manager (chair).
* Take minutes, record decisions and actions, and follow up to completion.
* Coordinate the ECAB for emergency changes at short notice.

CMDB coordination (infrastructure)
  
  

* Maintain infrastructure configuration item (CI) records in the CMDB — creating, updating and retiring CIs as changes are delivered.
* Link each change to the CIs it affects so impact assessment and reporting stay accurate.
* Run routine CMDB housekeeping: spot gaps, duplicates and stale records, and support audit and reconciliation activity under the Change Manager.
* Escalate CMDB data-quality issues and model changes to the Change Manager.

Tracking, closure & records
  
  

* Progress each CAB Request through the JSM statuses — Assess & Evaluate, approvals, Approved for Deployment, In Progress, Post-Deployment Validation, closed.
* Confirm post-deployment validation (health checks) is recorded and chase outstanding closures.
* Capture post-implementation review notes and lessons learned; maintain accurate, auditable records.
* Produce routine change reports and metrics extracts for the Change Manager.

**Authority & boundaries**

* Authorised to log, categorise (with Manager), schedule and progress changes, and to hold changes that do not meet process requirements.
* Does not authorise major or emergency changes and does not chair the CAB — these sit with the Change Manager.
* Escalates contested, high-risk or non-compliant changes to the Change Manager.

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

title: Global Trial Acceleration Associate
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* The Global Trial Acceleration Associate is responsible for managing and executing on centralized activities in support of global trials with an emphasis on clinical documentation.
* The Global Trial Acceleration Associate will interact with clinical study sites, CROs/vendors, Country Trial Managers (CTM)/Clinical Trial Monitor (CTMo.), the study team and other functional areas within BMS and will provide support to the Study Team throughout the study duration (start-up, maintenance, and close-out of clinical studies).
* As the main point of contact for essential document management, ethical and regulatory submission-related activities, develops and maintains collaborative working relationships with relevant stakeholders.
* Support outsourcing activities by interfacing with operational teams, support groups and service providers for successful selection, contracting and execution of outsourced studies while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, ethical practices, BMS outsourcing and procurement policies and procedures.
* Initiate and manage start-up documentation activities for global clinical trials.
* Submission of potential investigators to CTSS for debarment review and tracking of decisions.
* Responsible for country/Site Activation for clinical trials as applicable per region; this includes the final review of applicable documents, final sign-off of the country/site activation checklist. The incumbent may also be responsible for activating the site in accordance with all applicable global / local study procedures.
* May provide a level of quality control of start-up activity.
* Update and review of various study-related clinical systems to determine and report status of clinical trial documents for insourced studies (i.e., CTMS, eTMF, etc. or corresponding vendor systems)
* May arrange certified translation of study level documentation from translators as requested (i.e., ICF, Protocol, IB)
* May assist with the coordination or creation of other study specific materials such as pharmacy or Investigator site file to ensure that these are available on site for site initiation visits/prior to first patient visit.
* May act as single point of contact for the study team for centralized activities during study start-up.
* Ongoing maintenance and tracking of essential documentation and collection of updated/outstanding documentation and submission as required during all phases of clinical trial.
* Ongoing communication with study teams regarding centralized study activities.
* Maybe responsible for creation and management of standardized document templates.
* Assist with CSR distribution
* Country and site level ICF adaptation.
* Essential document collection, review and approval of country and site level documents.
* Centrally reviewing all the Site Monitoring Visit reports, issue escalation, resolution and follow up tasks.
* Other duties as assigned to support Clinical Trials.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in legal, Life science, Business Administration, or equivalent experience. Advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant clinical development & operational experience in Pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO or similar fields, is required.
* Seasoned field monitor with min 3+ years of global site monitoring (Clinical Research Associate) report review experience is preferred.
* Prior therapeutic area expertise (eg: Oncology, Cardiology, Hematology, Immunology etc) is preferred.
* Hands-on experience preparing, reviewing, and submitting regulatory documentation to IRB/IECs and Regulatory Agencies; including formulating responses to queries.
* Hands-on experience of preparing, reviewing, and submitting clinical study start-up / activation documentation, including responses to queries.
* Knowledge of ICH / GCP and regulatory guidelines/directives, understanding of drug development process and Pharma, Strong organizational, time-management, analytical and decision-making skills to efficiently evaluate, plan and accomplish work goals.
* Effective communication skills in English (written & oral), computer skills - MS office suite, SharePoint, etc. CTMS (Veeva Vault experience preferred, knowledge of portals, databases and other Clinical Trial enabling technologies
* Proven experience in managing key internal and external stakeholders effectively by frequently soliciting input and gathering and incorporating feedback into processes as appropriate.
* Effective management or support of cross-functional, multi-cultural teams and demonstrated ability to work and influence within a matrix structure.
* Proven time management skills and ability to be flexible to meet job demands, manage multiple priorities, and take on new initiatives and improvement efforts.
* Demonstrates a high level of adaptability in dealing with ambiguous and complex work environment and balances multiple demands on role in a responsive and professional manner.
* Ability to sustain high levels of performance in a constantly changing environment.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. title: System Specialist
description:
*Diasorin is a global leader in diagnostic solutions, pushing the boundaries of science and technology to create cutting-edge tools that improve healthcare worldwide. With a legacy spanning over 50 years, we've earned our reputation for excellence by developing innovative diagnostic assays and instruments that are trusted by healthcare providers around the world.*
*Our broad offering of diagnostic tests and Licensed Technology solutions, made available thanks to ongoing investments in research, positions us as the player with the widest range of specialty solutions in the sector and identifies us as the "Diagnostics Specialist."*
***Why Join Diasorin?***

* Impactful Work: When you join Diasorin, you become part of a team that's dedicated to improving lives. Your contributions will directly impact patient care, making a meaningful difference in the world.
* Global Reach & Innovation: Our work transcends borders. Joining Diasorin means collaborating with colleagues from all over the world, expanding your horizons, and contributing to global healthcare solutions at the forefront of the diagnostic industry.

*Diverse and Inclusive Culture: We believe in the strength of diversity, and our inclusive culture reflects this commitment. We value your unique perspective and offer a supportive, collaborative environment where everyone can thrive.*
*Join Our Team: If you're passionate about innovation, diversity, and making a positive impact on healthcare, Diasorin is the place for you. We're looking for passionate and talented individuals who are ready to embrace new challenges and drive healthcare solutions forward.*
*Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team that's shaping the future of diagnostics? Join Diasorin and become a catalyst for change in the world of healthcare. Apply today and be a part of our exciting journey toward a healthier, more connected world. Together, we can make an impact!*
**Job Scope**
To provide technical service (in alignment with approved local and group practice) and support to customers with instrument maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, education and repair on our analytical devices. Promote the image of the company in co-operation with sales and specialist workforce. Become a specialist in frontline service of the device group.
  
  
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**

* Comprehensively understand and grasp the particularity of the technology, application, and maintenance of DiaSorin products. Participate in the training courses on DiaSorin Products, technologies and services, and pass the training examination.
* Providing technical service and maintenance service support to dealers and to end users, in and after sales: Assist sales team with technical inputs, demonstrations to successfully close details.
* Frequently visit the users for monitoring the satisfaction and technical demand of end users of DiaSorin company and distributors. Produce weekly work reports for discussion and for Service Managers approvals.
* Monitoring the technological advantages and disadvantages and application situations of the competing products in the market, produce monthly report for discussion for Service Managers approvals.
* Manage and report all activities through SFDC on a daily basis as per the corporate policies. Other missions assigned by DHIPL, Country Manager and National Service Manager.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies and supplying adequate inputs into the service organization. Handle, manage and maintain spare parts and car stock through SGAT.
* Provide technical service and maintenance service support to end users as per the organizational requirements.
* All the service activities have to be captured in SFDC on a daily basis and all the calls to be concluded on the same day as per corporate policies.
* All country stock spare parts inventory status to be updated on a monthly basis.
* Any other task may be assigned by the National Service Manager from time to time.

**Education, Experience, And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or diploma in Engineering
* 5-7 years in a field directly related to the work
* Previous experience in the IVD (In Vitro Diagnostics) and/or highly regulated environments and biotechnology industry.
* Previous IVD service experience
* Knowledge and skill in preventative maintenance in installing, servicing, troubleshooting, repairing, calibrating, and maintaining medical diagnostic or clinical laboratory instrumentation
* Knowledge/understanding of electronics and medical terminology
* Ability to demonstrate and explain correct operation of equipment
* Understanding of good laboratory practices and techniques
* Working knowledge of diagnostic equipment
* Current Drivers Licence

**What We Offer**
Receive a competitive salary and benefits package as you grow your career at DiaSorin. Join our team and discover how your work can impact the lives of people all over the world.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.*

title: Senior Knowledge Engineer, AI Enablement & Knowledge Systems
description:

Based on the evolution of AI and knowledge management within Customer Support, knowledge quality, governance, retrieval, and usability are increasingly foundational to AI effectiveness and support outcomes.

**AI Knowledge Readiness**
Identify, structure, and groom content that feeds GHX's AI platform. Partner with AI and data teams to ensure knowledge assets are formatted, accurate, and optimized for ingestion. Monitor AI solution performance and drive content improvements that translate into measurable efficiency gains.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Knowledge Management & Content Quality**

* Manage the intake, triage, and routing of knowledge-related requests from operational teams.

* Identify obsolete, duplicate, or conflicting content and drive resolution through appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct knowledge audits and implement improvement cycles based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.
* Translate operational knowledge into structured, AI-ingestible formats ensuring accuracy, consistency, and taxonomy compliance.

**AI Knowledge Readiness & Technology**

* Structure and groom knowledge content for ingestion into GHX's AI platforms; ensure format, tagging, and taxonomy standards are met.
* Monitor AI platform performance related to knowledge quality; recommend and track content-driven improvements.
* Partner with data scientists and AI developers to understand ingestion requirements and close content gaps.

**Process Improvement & Analysis**

* Analyze and document knowledge workflows, identifying gaps or structural issues that reduce content usability or AI accuracy.
* Interpret usage data, feedback trends, and engagement metrics to recommend improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation of governance standards, taxonomy structures, and documentation templates.
* Learn and apply Lean/Six Sigma and knowledge-centered service (KCS) frameworks where applicable.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with SMEs, operational leaders, and AI teams to promote adoption of AI-enabled knowledge systems.
* Provide end-user training and support on knowledge tools, systems, and updated content resources.
* Collect stakeholder requirements and develop content solutions that meet operational team needs.
* Present knowledge health findings and recommendations to leadership with clear next steps.

**Required Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor message by audience.
* Familiarity with knowledge management systems (Confluence/Atlassian, Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret usage data and translate findings into action.
* Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple knowledge domains and adjust priorities as needed.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, SharePoint, Forms); CRM familiarity a plus (Salesforce preferred).
* Self-directed learner who identifies gaps and takes initiative to close them.
* Understanding of how content structure and taxonomy affect AI/ML model performance preferred.

**Education & Experience**

* 2+ years of related experience in knowledge management, operations enablement, content governance, or business analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining content for both human consumption (training, SOPs) and machine ingestion (AI platforms, knowledge bases).
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Organizational Development, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
